APPROVED. Proceed with the foundation fixes and Phase 1 preparation.
We are building a serious, production-quality classifieds/directory theme with UX and polish comparable to mature commercial themes such as Classima.
DO NOT stop at basic functionality.
However, DO NOT start building the major new classifieds UI yet.
First implement the audit fixes and foundation improvements identified in the read-only audit.
==================================================
DECISIONS
=========
1. CUSTOM HEADER:
   REMOVE the dead custom-header/flexible-header support.
Do NOT implement header_image().
The Customizer must not expose a header-image control that has no effect.
2. RTL:
   IMPLEMENT proper RTL support.
Do not merely remove the rtl-language-support claim.
Create a proper rtl.css appropriate for the existing CSS architecture.
Ensure the theme behaves correctly in RTL for:
* navigation
* spacing
* icons where direction matters
* grids
* sidebar layout
* breadcrumbs
* forms
* buttons
* pagination
* mobile navigation
Do not blindly mirror every property. Only change direction-sensitive properties.
Update style.css/readme metadata appropriately.
3. FONTS:
   SELF-HOST the selected font families as WOFF2 files.
Do NOT load fonts.googleapis.com.
Use only the weights actually needed by the design.
Use proper @font-face declarations.
Use font-display: swap.
Ensure the theme still has a robust system-font fallback stack.
Do not add unnecessary font files.
==================================================
FIX THE 18 AUDIT DEFECTS
========================
Implement all concrete defects identified in the audit.
### 1. theme.json phantom templates
Remove stale customTemplates entries for:
* template-listings
* template-submit
* template-dashboard
* template-wishlist
They no longer exist.
Do not recreate those plugin-dependent templates merely to satisfy theme.json.
### 2. theme.json templateParts
Remove stale templateParts declarations if they do not correspond to actual block template parts.
This is a classic theme, not a block theme.
Do not create fake parts/*.html files simply to satisfy theme.json.
### 3. Archive handling
Create a proper archive.php.
It should provide:
* archive heading
* archive description where available
* standard WordPress loop
* pagination
* empty state
* accessible heading hierarchy
Also improve index.php fallback behavior where necessary.
Archive pages that should have useful headings include:
* category
* tag
* author
* date
* generic archive
Do not add plugin-specific archive logic.
### 4. Design token consolidation
There are currently two competing token systems:
* --listingcore-*
* --color- / --space- / --text-*
Consolidate them into ONE canonical design-token system.
Before changing references, map every existing token to its replacement.
Do not blindly rename tokens.
The final system must cover:
* colors
* typography
* spacing
* radius
* shadows
* layout/container widths
* transitions where appropriate
Keep the ListingCore naming convention if that provides the cleanest migration path.
Remove obsolete duplicate tokens after all references are migrated.
Do not leave two competing systems.
### 5. Palette single source of truth
The palette is currently duplicated in:
* theme.json
* style.css :root
* editor-style.css :root
* Customizer defaults
Create one canonical source wherever practical.
The front end and editor must remain visually consistent.
Do not allow:
--color-primary
and
--listingcore-primary
to represent different blues.
Use the same canonical values everywhere.
### 6. Customizer color variants
When the primary/accent color changes, all dependent variants must update correctly.
Fix:
* primary
* primary-dark
* primary-light
* accent
* accent-dark
* accent-light
* hover states
* active states
* tint/background states
Do not hard-code old colors into component CSS.
### 7. Dead post-meta hook
Remove:
listingcore_theme_post_meta()
if it is genuinely unused.
Do not retain dead hooks/functions merely for historical compatibility.
### 8. Dead after-loop hook
Remove:
listingcore_theme_after_loop()
if no template fires the hook.
Remove associated dead callback registrations.
### 9. Search template duplication
Make search.php use:
template-parts/content-search.php
Remove duplicate inline markup.
There must be one canonical search-result presentation.
### 10. Mobile menu
The registered mobile menu location must actually work.
Implement proper mobile navigation behavior.
Desktop and mobile menu presentation must be intentional.
The mobile toggle must open the correct navigation.
Do not simply duplicate the desktop menu unnecessarily if WordPress menu locations allow a cleaner implementation.
### 11. Custom header support
Already decided: REMOVE dead custom-header/flexible-header support.
### 12. RTL
Already decided: IMPLEMENT properly with rtl.css.
### 13. Hero Customizer controls
Register:
* hero_title
* hero_subtitle
in the Customizer.
Ensure front-page.php actually responds to them.
Provide sensible defaults.
Escape output correctly.
Make the controls usable without requiring any plugin.
### 14. Copyright setting
Make:
listingcore_theme_copyright
actually control the footer output.
Sanitize the setting appropriately.
Escape the final output.
If the setting is empty, provide a sensible default.
### 15. Dead localized JS payload
Remove listingcoreThemeData if main.js does not require it.
Do not localize unnecessary data to every page.
### 16. Dead helpers
Remove genuinely unused helpers:
* site_logo
* site_tagline
* primary_nav
* mobile_nav
* get_thumbnail_url
* empty customize_preview_js placeholder
Before deleting each function, verify there are no references anywhere in the repository.
Do not delete anything that is actually used.
### 17. Google Fonts
Remove all Google Fonts network requests.
Use the approved self-hosted WOFF2 fonts.
Ensure enqueue logic does not load fonts unnecessarily on admin pages.
### 18. Image sizes
Audit the four existing custom image sizes:
* listing-thumb
* listing-hero
* category-icon
* avatar
Do NOT automatically remove them if the upcoming theme presentation will use them.
However, because we are going to build listing/card presentation later, determine which image sizes have a legitimate theme-side use.
Keep only sizes justified by actual theme presentation.
Do not register unnecessary derivative sizes.
==================================================
ACCESSIBILITY FIXES
===================
Implement the audit's accessibility findings now.
### Smooth scrolling
Current smooth-scroll behavior is too broad.
It must:
* only affect appropriate internal anchors
* not interfere with plugin/block functionality
* respect prefers-reduced-motion
* not hijack unrelated anchors
* preserve browser behavior where appropriate
If reduced motion is requested, do not force animated scrolling.
### Mobile menu focus
Improve the mobile menu:
* move focus appropriately when opened
* allow keyboard navigation
* Escape closes it
* return focus to the triggering button
* maintain aria-expanded correctly
* maintain aria-controls where appropriate
### Search panel focus
Do the same for the search panel:
* focus management
* Escape
* return focus
* correct aria-expanded
* keyboard usability
### ARIA cleanup
Remove redundant landmark roles from native semantic elements where unnecessary:
<header>
<main>
<footer>
<aside>
Use semantic HTML directly.
Keep ARIA only where it adds actual information/functionality.
### Thumbnail links
Do not hide a real interactive link using:
aria-hidden="true"
tabindex="-1"
Fix the image/link structure correctly.
Use meaningful link semantics and appropriate alt handling.
==================================================
MOBILE FOUNDATION
=================
Add proper responsive handling for:
360px
390px
414px
Audit:
* containers
* grids
* flex children
* cards
* navigation
* forms
* headings
* buttons
Add appropriate:
min-width: 0
overflow-wrap
word-break behavior
only where necessary.
Do NOT use:
overflow-x: hidden
as a blanket fix for layout problems.
Find and fix the actual source of overflow.
==================================================
BREADCRUMBS
===========
Improve the existing breadcrumb system.
Support appropriate hierarchy for:
* pages
* parent/child pages
* posts
* categories
* archives
Where appropriate, include category context in post breadcrumbs.
Add BreadcrumbList structured data only if it can be implemented correctly and without creating invalid or duplicate schema.
Do not create schema merely for SEO decoration.
==================================================
ARCHIVE UX
==========
The archive experience should look intentional and polished.
Include:
* archive title
* description where available
* content count if useful and available
* consistent spacing
* pagination
* empty state
Do not invent counts.
==================================================
DESIGN SYSTEM CLEANUP
=====================
While implementing the fixes, organize the existing CSS into a coherent structure.
Do NOT rewrite all 3,700+ lines blindly.
Preserve working styles.
Remove dead CSS only when you have verified it has no legitimate use.
The existing stylesheet already contains substantial listing-card, dashboard, filter, hero, and CTA styling.
Do not discard that work.
==================================================
SEO FOUNDATION
==============
Maintain semantic heading structure.
Ensure:
* exactly one appropriate primary page heading where applicable
* archive headings
* search heading
* 404 heading
* homepage heading
Do not add keyword-stuffed text.
Ensure title/meta functionality remains compatible with WordPress SEO plugins without requiring them.
==================================================
QUALITY GATES
=============
After implementing these changes:
1. Run php -l on every PHP file.
2. Verify theme.json parses.
3. Search for:
   * do_shortcode
   * add_shortcode
   * register_post_type
   * register_taxonomy
   * tgmpa
   * class-tgm
   * is_plugin_active
   * plugin-install.php
4. Confirm no mandatory plugin dependency exists.
5. Confirm no Google Fonts requests remain.
6. Confirm every require/include path exists.
7. Confirm every deleted helper has zero references.
8. Confirm every registered Customizer setting is actually consumed.
9. Confirm every JS localization is actually consumed.
10. Confirm no stale template names remain in theme.json.
11. Confirm RTL support exists.
12. Confirm no dead custom-header support remains.
13. Confirm no redundant landmark roles remain.
14. Confirm mobile menu location is actually rendered.
15. Confirm copyright setting is actually consumed.
16. Regenerate the POT file.
Do not create the final ZIP.
Do not move to the major classifieds UI yet.
At the end provide:
* files changed
* files added
* files removed
* defects fixed
* accessibility improvements
* design-token changes
* font implementation
* RTL implementation
* any remaining issues
Then STOP.
Do not proceed to Phase 2 automatically.

== Description ==

ListingCore Theme is a **high-performance, zero-builder** theme for marketplace, directory, and classifieds style websites. Layouts are native PHP templates and CSS — no page-builder runtime on the front end — so pages stay fast and cache-friendly.

The theme is **standalone**. It activates and renders the homepage, pages, posts, archives, search, 404, comments, widgets, menus, and the Customizer with **zero plugins installed**. No plugin is required, and the theme never installs or activates a plugin for you.

= Highlights =

* Zero-builder hero search layout and grid archives
* Custom menus, featured images, custom logo, and custom background
* Customizer brand colors, homepage hero text, sidebar position, and footer copyright
* Self-hosted Plus Jakarta Sans and JetBrains Mono (no Google Fonts requests)
* Right-to-left (RTL) layout support
* Block editor patterns, wide blocks, editor styles, and a matching color palette
* Footer widget columns, primary sidebar, and homepage widget area
* Translation-ready strings with the `listingcore-theme` text domain
* Accessible navigation with keyboard and screen-reader support

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""Generate languages/listingcore-theme.pot from PHP sources."""
from __future__ import annotations

import re
from collections import OrderedDict
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(r"C:\Projects\listingcore_theme")
DOMAIN = "listingcore-theme"
OUT = ROOT / "languages" / "listingcore-theme.pot"

STRING_FUNCS = (
    "esc_html__",
    "esc_attr__",
    "__",
    "esc_html_e",
    "esc_attr_e",
    "_e",
)
CONTEXT_FUNCS = (
    "esc_html_x",
    "esc_attr_x",
    "_x",
    "_ex",
)
PLURAL_FUNCS = ("_n", "_nx")

# Single- or double-quoted PHP string, with simple escapes.
Q = r"""(?:'(?:\\.|[^'\\])*'|"(?:\\.|[^"\\])*")"""


def unquote(token: str) -> str:
    token = token.strip()
    quote = token[0]
    body = token[1:-1]
    if quote == "'":
        return body.replace("\\'", "'").replace("\\\\", "\\")
    return (
        body.replace('\\"', '"')
        .replace("\\n", "\n")
        .replace("\\t", "\t")
        .replace("\\\\", "\\")
    )


def php_escape(text: str) -> str:
    return text.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace('"', '\\"')


def wrap_msgid(text: str, keyword: str = "msgid") -> str:
    if "\n" in text:
        lines = text.split("\n")
        out = [f'{keyword} ""']
        for i, line in enumerate(lines):
            suffix = "\\n" if i < len(lines) - 1 else ""
            out.append(f'"{php_escape(line)}{suffix}"')
        return "\n".join(out)
    return f'{keyword} "{php_escape(text)}"'


entries: "OrderedDict[tuple, dict]" = OrderedDict()


def add_entry(msgid: str, refs: list[str], *, msgid_plural: str | None = None, msgctxt: str | None = None, extracted: str | None = None):
    key = (msgctxt or "", msgid, msgid_plural or "")
    if key not in entries:
        entries[key] = {
            "msgid": msgid,
            "msgid_plural": msgid_plural,
            "msgctxt": msgctxt,
            "refs": [],
            "extracted": extracted,
        }
    for ref in refs:
        if ref not in entries[key]["refs"]:
            entries[key]["refs"].append(ref)
    if extracted and not entries[key]["extracted"]:
        entries[key]["extracted"] = extracted


def translator_comment_before(text: str, index: int) -> str | None:
    window = text[max(0, index - 400) : index]
    match = re.search(r"/\*\s*translators:\s*(.*?)\*/", window, re.S | re.I)
    if not match:
        return None
    return re.sub(r"\s+", " ", match.group(1)).strip()


def process_file(path: Path) -> None:
    rel = path.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()
    text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    lines = text.splitlines()

    def line_no(idx: int) -> int:
        return text.count("\n", 0, idx) + 1

    # Simple / echo / esc_*__
    simple_re = re.compile(
        r"\b(" + "|".join(STRING_FUNCS) + r")\s*\(\s*(" + Q + r")\s*,\s*['\"]" + DOMAIN + r"['\"]",
        re.S,
    )
    for m in simple_re.finditer(text):
        msgid = unquote(m.group(2))
        add_entry(msgid, [f"{rel}:{line_no(m.start())}"], extracted=translator_comment_before(text, m.start()))

    context_re = re.compile(
        r"\b(" + "|".join(CONTEXT_FUNCS) + r")\s*\(\s*(" + Q + r")\s*,\s*(" + Q + r")\s*,\s*['\"]" + DOMAIN + r"['\"]",
        re.S,
    )
    for m in context_re.finditer(text):
        msgid = unquote(m.group(2))
        ctx = unquote(m.group(3))
        add_entry(msgid, [f"{rel}:{line_no(m.start())}"], msgctxt=ctx, extracted=translator_comment_before(text, m.start()))

    plural_re = re.compile(
        r"\b(_n|_nx)\s*\(\s*(" + Q + r")\s*,\s*(" + Q + r")\s*,",
        re.S,
    )
    for m in plural_re.finditer(text):
        # Domain is later in the call; require it nearby.
        trailing = text[m.end() : m.end() + 400]
        if DOMAIN not in trailing:
            continue
        msgid = unquote(m.group(2))
        plural = unquote(m.group(3))
        ctx = None
        if m.group(1) == "_nx":
            ctx_m = re.search(r"(" + Q + r")\s*,\s*['\"]" + DOMAIN + r"['\"]", trailing)
            if ctx_m:
                ctx = unquote(ctx_m.group(1))
        add_entry(
            msgid,
            [f"{rel}:{line_no(m.start())}"],
            msgid_plural=plural,
            msgctxt=ctx,
            extracted=translator_comment_before(text, m.start()),
        )


for php in sorted(ROOT.rglob("*.php")):
    process_file(php)

now = datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M+0000")

chunks = [
    "# Copyright (C) 2026 virendrasingh06",
    "# This file is distributed under the GNU General Public License v2 or later.",
    'msgid ""',
    'msgstr ""',
    '"Project-Id-Version: ListingCore Theme 1.0.0\\n"',
    '"Report-Msgid-Bugs-To: https://wordpress.org/support/theme/listingcore-theme\\n"',
    f'"POT-Creation-Date: {now}\\n"',
    '"MIME-Version: 1.0\\n"',
    '"Content-Type: text/plain; charset=UTF-8\\n"',
    '"Content-Transfer-Encoding: 8bit\\n"',
    '"PO-Revision-Date: YEAR-MO-DA HO:MI+ZONE\\n"',
    '"Last-Translator: FULL NAME <EMAIL@ADDRESS>\\n"',
    '"Language-Team: LANGUAGE <LL@li.org>\\n"',
    '"Plural-Forms: nplurals=INTEGER; plural=EXPRESSION;\\n"',
    f'"X-Generator: ListingCore Theme potgen\\n"',
    f'"X-Domain: {DOMAIN}\\n"',
    "",
]

for key, entry in entries.items():
    if entry["extracted"]:
        chunks.append(f"#. translators: {entry['extracted']}")
    for ref in entry["refs"]:
        chunks.append(f"#: {ref}")
    if entry["msgctxt"]:
        chunks.append(f'msgctxt "{php_escape(entry["msgctxt"])}"')
    chunks.append(wrap_msgid(entry["msgid"]))
    if entry["msgid_plural"]:
        chunks.append(wrap_msgid(entry["msgid_plural"], "msgid_plural"))
        chunks.append('msgstr[0] ""')
        chunks.append('msgstr[1] ""')
    else:
        chunks.append('msgstr ""')
    chunks.append("")

OUT.write_text("\n".join(chunks) + "\n", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")
print(f"Wrote {len(entries)} entries to {OUT}")

Phase 1 foundation work is in place. Major classifieds UI was not started.

## Files added
- `archive.php`
- `rtl.css`
- `assets/css/fonts.css`
- `assets/fonts/plus-jakarta-sans-{400,500,600,700,800}.woff2`
- `assets/fonts/jetbrains-mono-{400,500}.woff2`
- `assets/fonts/LICENSE.txt`

## Files changed
- `theme.json`, `style.css`, `readme.txt`, `header.php`, `search.php`, `index.php`, `front-page.php`, `archive.php` (new), `404.php`, `page.php`, `single.php`, `sidebar.php`, `footer.php`
- `template-parts/content.php`, `template-parts/content-search.php`
- `inc/customizer.php`, `inc/enqueue.php`, `inc/theme-setup.php`, `inc/template-functions.php`, `inc/template-hooks.php`, `inc/woocommerce.php`
- `assets/css/editor-style.css`, `assets/js/main.js`
- `languages/listingcore-theme.pot`

## Files removed
No template files were deleted in this phase. Earlier standalone-refactor deletions (`template-listings.php`, `template-submit.php`, `template-dashboard.php`, `template-wishlist.php`, CPT/plugin modules, and related templates) remain deleted and were not recreated.

Dead functions/hooks removed from remaining PHP: `listingcore_theme_post_meta()`, `listingcore_theme_after_loop()`, `site_logo`, `site_tagline`, `primary_nav`, `mobile_nav`, `get_thumbnail_url`, empty Customizer preview JS, and `listingcoreThemeData`.

---

## Defects fixed
1. Stale `customTemplates` removed from `theme.json`.
2. Stale `templateParts` removed (classic theme, no `parts/*.html`).
3. Proper `archive.php` with title, description, count, loop, pagination, empty state; `index.php` fallback headings improved.
4–5. One canonical token system: `--listingcore-*`. Conflicting `--color-primary` (`#2563eb`) vs `--listingcore-primary` (`#1a56db`) resolved to `#1a56db` everywhere.
6. Customizer primary/accent now rewrite dark/bright/light variants; hover/active/tint use those tokens.
7–8. Dead post-meta and after-loop hooks removed.
9. `search.php` uses `template-parts/content-search.php`.
10. Mobile menu location renders `#listingcore-mobile-nav` when assigned; otherwise primary nav is the drawer.
11. `custom-header` / `flexible-header` support and tags removed.
12. Real RTL via `rtl.css`.
13. `hero_title` / `hero_subtitle` registered and consumed on `front-page.php`.
14. `listingcore_theme_copyright` controls the footer, with a default when empty.
15. Dead JS localization removed.
16. Listed unused helpers removed (verified zero references).
17. No Google Fonts network requests; self-hosted WOFF2 only.
18. Image sizes kept with justification: `listing-grid`, `listing-single`, and `blog-thumb` are in use; `listing-thumb`, `listing-hero`, `category-icon`, and `avatar` are reserved for upcoming listing presentation.

## Accessibility
- Smooth scroll is scoped to same-page content anchors, ignores tabs/dialogs/modifier clicks, and respects `prefers-reduced-motion`.
- Mobile menu: `aria-expanded` / `aria-controls`, focus move, Tab trap, Escape, overlay, return focus.
- Search panel: same label/expanded/focus/Escape/return-focus behavior (no full dialog trap).
- Redundant landmark roles removed from `<header>`, `<main>`, `<footer>`, `<aside>`.
- Thumbnail links are real links with empty decorative `alt` plus screen-reader title text (no `aria-hidden` / `tabindex="-1"`).

## Design tokens
Canonical `--listingcore-*` now covers colors (including primary/accent variants, gray-400/600, border), type, spacing (including `space-24`), radius, shadows, container/sidebar widths, and transitions. Short `--color-` / `--space-` / `--text-*` tokens are gone. `theme.json`, `style.css`, `editor-style.css`, and Customizer defaults share `#1a56db` / `#f59e0b`.

## Fonts
Self-hosted Plus Jakarta Sans 400–800 and JetBrains Mono 400/500 as WOFF2. `@font-face` uses `font-display: swap`. Fallback: `system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif`. Loaded on the front end and in the editor only, not across wp-admin.

## RTL
`rtl.css` in the theme root (WordPress loads it for RTL locales). Overrides are limited to direction-sensitive items: off-canvas transform, directional arrows, search-field text alignment. Layout already uses logical properties (`inset-inline-*`, `padding-inline`, `border-inline-start`, `text-align: start`). Tags keep `rtl-language-support`.

## Quality gates
- `php -l` clean on all 27 PHP files
- `theme.json` parses; no stale templates/parts
- No `do_shortcode`, `add_shortcode`, `register_post_type`, `register_taxonomy`, TGM, `is_plugin_active`, or `plugin-install.php`
- No mandatory plugin dependency
- No `fonts.googleapis.com`
- Every `require`/`include` target exists
- Deleted helpers have zero references
- Every Customizer setting is consumed
- No leftover JS localization
- No dead custom-header support
- No redundant landmark roles
- Mobile menu location is rendered
- Copyright setting is consumed
- POT regenerated (`languages/listingcore-theme.pot`, 139 entries)

## Remaining issues
- `listingcore_theme_post_thumbnail()` is still defined and unused; kept as a presentation helper, not one of the listed dead helpers.
- Archive/search cards still have two links to the same URL (image + title). The image link is now named instead of hidden.
- POT was generated without WP-CLI. Re-run `wp i18n make-pot` when CLI is available if you want WordPress.org-tooling metadata.
- No running WordPress site here, so 360/390/414 and RTL were not browser-verified.
- Listing-card, dashboard, filter, and CTA CSS was preserved for later UI work, not rebuilt.

Stopped here. Not starting Phase 2, and not creating a ZIP.

PHASE 1 FOUNDATION IS APPROVED.

Now begin PHASE 2: CLASSIFIEDS / DIRECTORY PRESENTATION SYSTEM.

This is the first major product/UI phase.

Our goal is to make the theme feel like a mature, premium classifieds/directory product with UX quality comparable to established commercial themes such as Classima.

DO NOT copy Classima's code, assets, branding, or proprietary implementation.

Build our own implementation using the existing ListingCore design language.

==================================================
NON-NEGOTIABLE ARCHITECTURE
===========================

The theme MUST remain functional with ZERO plugins.

Do NOT:

* register a listing CPT
* register listing taxonomies
* recreate ListingCore business logic
* recreate payment processing
* require ListingCore
* require WooCommerce
* require Elementor
* add TGM
* add plugin installation prompts
* add mandatory shortcodes
* add plugin-specific database tables
* add plugin-specific business logic

The theme owns PRESENTATION.

The ListingCore plugin may later provide DATA/FUNCTIONALITY.

Therefore design the presentation layer so it can consume WordPress-native content now and ListingCore data later through clean optional integration.

==================================================
FIRST TASK — AUDIT EXISTING LISTING STYLES
==========================================

Before coding, inspect the existing CSS and template files.

There are already substantial styles for:

* listing cards
* listing grids
* filters
* hero
* dashboard
* CTA
* badges
* metadata
* responsive layouts

Do NOT throw this work away.

Determine:

1. Which existing styles are reusable.
2. Which are incomplete.
3. Which are inconsistent.
4. Which selectors are orphaned.
5. Which components need markup.
6. Which components need CSS refinement.

Create a component inventory before implementation.

Then proceed.

==================================================
PHASE 2A — LISTING CARD SYSTEM
==============================

Build a canonical reusable listing-card presentation system.

The card should support:

* image
* image fallback
* featured badge
* category badge

* optional verification badge
* optional promoted badge

The card must have clear visual hierarchy:

IMAGE
↓
BADGES
↓
TITLE
↓
PRICE
↓
LOCATION / METADATA
↓
SELLER / DATE / ACTIONS

Do not overcrowd the card.

Support:

* grid card
* horizontal/list card

Do not create separate unrelated card systems.

Create one canonical component structure with modifiers.

Cards must remain attractive when:

* title is very long
* price is missing
* image is missing
* location is missing
* seller is missing
* metadata is incomplete

==================================================
PHASE 2B — IMAGE SYSTEM
=======================

Create a consistent listing image presentation system.

Use the existing image sizes where appropriate:

* listing-grid
* listing-single
* blog-thumb

The reserved sizes may now be evaluated:

* listing-thumb
* listing-hero
* category-icon
* avatar

Only keep/register sizes that have a genuine presentation use.

Implement:

* aspect-ratio
* object-fit
* graceful placeholder
* lazy loading where appropriate
* responsive image support through WordPress APIs

Do not manually generate unnecessary image URLs.

==================================================
PHASE 2C — LISTING GRID
=======================

Create a reusable listing-grid component.

Support:

* 1 column mobile
* 2 columns where appropriate
* 3 columns desktop
* optional 4-column layout for suitable contexts

Do not force 4 columns when cards become too narrow.

Grid must have consistent:

* gaps
* card heights
* image ratios
* alignment

Test mentally and through CSS at:

360px
390px
414px
768px
1024px
1280px
1440px

==================================================
PHASE 2D — LISTING LIST VIEW
============================

Create a polished horizontal/list presentation.

It should support:

* thumbnail
* title
* price
* location
* metadata
* seller/date
* badges
* favorite/action

Ensure it collapses gracefully on mobile.

Do not create a separate duplicate data model.

==================================================
PHASE 2E — LISTING DETAIL PRESENTATION
======================================

Create the visual presentation layer for a future/supplied listing detail page.

Design:

* breadcrumb
* title
* price
* location
* metadata
* image gallery
* main image
* thumbnails
* description
* seller card
* contact CTA
* favorite CTA
* share CTA
* related listings
* sidebar where appropriate

IMPORTANT:

Do not create the listing CPT.

Do not create ListingCore business logic.

If no listing plugin is installed, do not produce a broken listing detail template.

Build reusable presentation components that can later be connected to ListingCore.

==================================================
PHASE 2F — SEARCH EXPERIENCE
============================

Create a polished classified search presentation.

The search area should support UI for:

* keyword
* category
* location
* price minimum
* price maximum
* additional filters
* search button
* reset
* sorting

The design should work as:

DESKTOP:
horizontal/structured search panel

MOBILE:
compact search + filter drawer

Do not make the theme responsible for processing plugin-specific filter parameters.

Where possible, use normal GET forms and semantic controls.

==================================================
PHASE 2G — FILTER DRAWER
========================

Build a reusable mobile filter drawer.

Requirements:

* accessible
* keyboard usable
* Escape closes
* focus returns to trigger
* overlay
* body scroll management
* correct aria-expanded
* correct aria-controls
* no focus trap bugs

Reuse the accessibility patterns established in Phase 1.

Do not duplicate the mobile-menu JavaScript unnecessarily.

Create reusable utilities where appropriate.

==================================================
PHASE 2H — SORTING / RESULT TOOLBAR
===================================

Create a polished results toolbar.

Support presentation for:

* result count
* sorting
* grid/list switch
* filter trigger
* active filter indicators

The toolbar must gracefully handle missing result counts.

Do not invent numbers.

==================================================
PHASE 2I — CATEGORIES
=====================

Create a category presentation system.

Support:

* category cards
* category icon/image
* category name
* optional count
* hover/focus state

Counts must only be shown when actual data is available.

Design categories so they can later consume ListingCore taxonomy data.

Do not register a taxonomy in the theme.

==================================================
PHASE 2J — LOCATIONS
====================

Create a location discovery presentation system.

Support:

* location cards
* location name
* optional listing count
* optional image
* optional icon

Again:

Do not create a theme-owned location database.

The theme should only provide presentation.

==================================================
PHASE 2K — HERO SEARCH
======================

Refine the homepage hero into a professional classifieds search experience.

Use the existing:

* hero_title
* hero_subtitle

Customizer settings.

Provide:

* prominent search field
* category selector presentation
* location selector presentation
* search CTA

The design must be excellent on mobile.

Do not hard-code ListingCore taxonomy data.

Use sensible WordPress-native fallbacks when no classified plugin exists.

==================================================
PHASE 2L — FEATURED / LATEST CONTENT
====================================

Create reusable sections for:

* Featured Listings presentation
* Latest Listings presentation
* Latest Posts

When no listing plugin exists:

Do not invent fake classified listings.

Use WordPress-native posts or display an intentional empty state.

When ListingCore integration is later added, the same presentation components should be usable.

==================================================
PHASE 2M — CTA COMPONENT
========================

Refine the existing CTA component.

It should support:

* title
* description
* primary CTA
* secondary CTA where appropriate
* responsive layout

It must remain useful without any plugin.

==================================================
PHASE 2N — EMPTY STATES
=======================

Create polished reusable empty states for:

* no search results
* no listings
* no category results
* no favorites
* no dashboard listings
* no image
* generic content unavailable

Empty states should be informative, not visually broken.

==================================================
PHASE 2O — BADGES
=================

Create a consistent badge system.

Support presentation for:

* Featured
* Promoted
* Verified
* New
* Category
* Status

Do not imply verification unless actual data says the entity is verified.

Do not invent listing status.

==================================================
PHASE 2P — FAVORITE / ACTION CONTROLS
=====================================

Create the visual component for:

* favorite
* share
* contact
* save/search action

These should be presentation-ready.

If functionality requires ListingCore, WooCommerce, or another plugin, keep the control safely inert or provide a graceful fallback.

Do not create fake functionality.

==================================================
PHASE 2Q — SELLER CARD
======================

Create a reusable seller profile card presentation.

Support:

* avatar
* name
* member information where available
* verification state where available
* contact CTA
* view listings CTA

Do not expose private information automatically.

Do not create user-management business logic.

==================================================
PHASE 2R — RESPONSIVE QUALITY
=============================

Every new component must be designed mobile-first.

Explicitly test CSS logic for:

360px
390px
414px
768px
1024px
1280px
1440px+

Pay particular attention to:

* card titles
* prices
* buttons
* filter controls
* search controls
* badges
* images
* long text
* sidebar collapse

No horizontal overflow.

==================================================
PHASE 2S — PERFORMANCE
======================

Do not add unnecessary JavaScript.

Prefer CSS for:

* layout
* hover
* transitions
* simple visual states

JavaScript should only handle actual interaction.

Use event delegation where appropriate.

Do not load scripts on pages where they are unnecessary.

Do not add external libraries.

==================================================
PHASE 2T — ACCESSIBILITY
========================

All new components must satisfy:

* keyboard navigation
* visible focus
* semantic headings
* correct button/link semantics
* meaningful labels
* screen-reader support
* reduced-motion support
* appropriate ARIA

Do not use:

aria-hidden="true"

to hide interactive content.

Do not use tabindex="-1" on real interactive controls.

==================================================
PHASE 2U — CSS ARCHITECTURE
===========================

Use the canonical --listingcore-* design token system from Phase 1.

Do NOT introduce:

--color-*
--space-*
--text-*

Do not create a second token system.

Organize components logically.

Avoid:

* duplicate selectors
* excessive specificity
* !important
* inline styles
* dead CSS

Before deleting old listing CSS, verify whether the upcoming components can use it.

==================================================
PHASE 2V — TEMPLATE ARCHITECTURE

Use reusable template parts.

For example, where appropriate:

template-parts/listing/

with components such as:

* card.php
* card-list.php
* gallery.php
* seller.php
* meta.php
* badges.php

Do not create files merely to follow this example.

Use the cleanest structure for the existing theme.

==================================================
PHASE 2W — OPTIONAL LISTINGCORE BRIDGE
======================================

Do NOT implement the actual ListingCore plugin integration yet.

However, structure the presentation layer so that a later optional bridge can supply:

* listing title
* price
* image
* location
* category
* metadata

The presentation component should not care where the data came from.

Keep data mapping separate from presentation.

==================================================
IMPORTANT — NO FAKE DATA
========================

Never hard-code fake:

* prices

Use real WordPress data when available.

<?php
/**
 * Listing presentation helpers.
 *
 * Maps WordPress-native content (and optional plugin-supplied arrays) into
 * a display DTO. No CPT, taxonomy, or marketplace business logic lives here.
 *
 * @package ListingCoreTheme
 * @since   1.0.0
 */

defined( 'ABSPATH' ) || exit;

/**
 * Post types that use listing-card markup.
 *
 * @return string[]
 */
function listingcore_theme_listing_card_post_types() {
	$types = [ 'post' ];

	/**
	 * Filter post types rendered with the listing card.
	 *
	 * @param string[] $types Post type names.
	 */
	return apply_filters( 'listingcore_theme_listing_card_post_types', $types );
}

/**
 * Whether the current (or given) post should use listing-card presentation.
 *
 * @param WP_Post|int|null $post Post.
 * @return bool
 */
function listingcore_theme_uses_listing_card( $post = null ) {
	$post = get_post( $post );

	if ( ! $post ) {
		return false;
	}

	return in_array( $post->post_type, listingcore_theme_listing_card_post_types(), true );
}

/**
 * Whether the current singular post should use listing detail presentation.
 *
 * Defaults to false so blog posts keep the standard single template.
 *
 * @param WP_Post|int|null $post Post.
 * @return bool
 */
function listingcore_theme_is_listing( $post = null ) {
	$post = get_post( $post );

	/**
	 * Filter whether a post is presented as a listing detail.
	 *
	 * @param bool         $is_listing Whether this is a listing.
	 * @param WP_Post|null $post       Post object.
	 */
	return (bool) apply_filters( 'listingcore_theme_is_listing', false, $post );
}

/**
 * Build a presentation item from a post. Empty fields stay empty.
 *
 * @param WP_Post|int|null $post Post.
 * @return array<string, mixed>
 */
function listingcore_theme_get_listing_item( $post = null ) {
	$post = get_post( $post );

	if ( ! $post ) {
		return [];
	}

	$post_id   = (int) $post->ID;
	$author_id = (int) $post->post_author;
	$published = get_post_timestamp( $post );

	$categories = [];
	$terms      = get_the_category( $post_id );
	if ( $terms && ! is_wp_error( $terms ) ) {
		foreach ( $terms as $term ) {
			$link = get_term_link( $term );
			$categories[] = [
				'name'  => $term->name,
				'url'   => is_wp_error( $link ) ? '' : $link,
				'count' => (int) $term->count,
			];
		}
	}

	$item = [
		'id'         => $post_id,
		'title'      => get_the_title( $post ),
		'url'        => get_permalink( $post ),
		'excerpt'    => get_the_excerpt( $post ),
		'date'       => get_the_date( '', $post ),
		'date_iso'   => get_the_date( DATE_W3C, $post ),
		'image_id'   => (int) get_post_thumbnail_id( $post_id ),
		'categories' => $categories,
		'price'      => '',
		'location'   => '',
		'featured'   => is_sticky( $post_id ),
		'promoted'   => false,
		'verified'   => false,
		'is_new'     => $published && ( time() - (int) $published ) < WEEK_IN_SECONDS,
		'status'     => '',
		'meta'       => [],
		'seller'     => [
			'id'         => $author_id,
			'name'       => $author_id ? get_the_author_meta( 'display_name', $author_id ) : '',
			'url'        => $author_id ? get_author_posts_url( $author_id ) : '',
			'avatar'     => $author_id ? get_avatar_url( $author_id, [ 'size' => 96 ] ) : '',
			'member'     => '',
			'verified'   => false,
			'listing_url'=> $author_id ? get_author_posts_url( $author_id ) : '',
		],
	];

	if ( $author_id ) {
		$registered = get_the_author_meta( 'user_registered', $author_id );
		if ( $registered ) {
			$item['seller']['member'] = sprintf(
				/* translators: %s: membership year */
				__( 'Member since %s', 'listingcore-theme' ),
				mysql2date( 'Y', $registered )
			);
		}
	}

	/**
	 * Filter listing presentation data. Plugins may fill price, location, etc.
	 *
	 * @param array   $item Presentation item.
	 * @param WP_Post $post Post object.
	 */
	return apply_filters( 'listingcore_theme_listing_item', $item, $post );
}

/**
 * Image size for a card layout.
 *
 * @param string $layout grid|list.
 * @return string
 */
function listingcore_theme_listing_image_size( $layout = 'grid' ) {
	return ( 'list' === $layout ) ? 'listingcore-listing-thumb' : 'listingcore-listing-grid';
}

/**
 * Current results view (grid or list). Presentation only.
 *
 * @return string
 */
function listingcore_theme_get_results_view() {
	$view = isset( $_GET['view'] ) ? sanitize_key( wp_unslash( $_GET['view'] ) ) : 'grid'; // phpcs:ignore WordPress.Security.NonceVerification.Recommended

	return in_array( $view, [ 'grid', 'list' ], true ) ? $view : 'grid';
}

/**
 * Allowed native sort keys.
 *
 * @return string[]
 */
function listingcore_theme_allowed_orderby() {
	return [ 'date', 'title' ];
}

/**
 * Current orderby from the request.
 *
 * @return string
 */
function listingcore_theme_get_orderby() {
	$value = isset( $_GET['orderby'] ) ? sanitize_key( wp_unslash( $_GET['orderby'] ) ) : 'date'; // phpcs:ignore WordPress.Security.NonceVerification.Recommended

	return in_array( $value, listingcore_theme_allowed_orderby(), true ) ? $value : 'date';
}

/**
 * Current order from the request.
 *
 * @return string
 */
function listingcore_theme_get_order() {
	$value = isset( $_GET['order'] ) ? strtoupper( sanitize_text_field( wp_unslash( $_GET['order'] ) ) ) : 'DESC'; // phpcs:ignore WordPress.Security.NonceVerification.Recommended

	return in_array( $value, [ 'ASC', 'DESC' ], true ) ? $value : 'DESC';
}

/**
 * Merge query args onto the current public URL.
 *
 * @param array $args Args to merge. Null values are removed.
 * @return string
 */
function listingcore_theme_results_url( $args = [] ) {
	$current = wp_unslash( $_GET ); // phpcs:ignore WordPress.Security.NonceVerification.Recommended
	$merged  = array_merge( is_array( $current ) ? $current : [], $args );

	foreach ( $merged as $key => $value ) {
		if ( null === $value || '' === $value ) {
			unset( $merged[ $key ] );
		}
	}

	unset( $merged['paged'] );

	$base = '';
	if ( is_search() ) {
		$base = home_url( '/' );
	} elseif ( is_category() || is_tag() || is_tax() || is_author() || is_date() || is_post_type_archive() ) {
		$base = (string) get_pagenum_link( 1, false );
		$base = strtok( $base, '?' );
	} else {
		$base = home_url( '/' );
	}

	return add_query_arg( $merged, $base );
}

/**
 * Active filter chips derived only from submitted GET values.
 *
 * @return array<int, array{label: string, url: string}>
 */
function listingcore_theme_get_active_filters() {
	$chips = [];
	$get   = wp_unslash( $_GET ); // phpcs:ignore WordPress.Security.NonceVerification.Recommended

	if ( ! empty( $get['s'] ) ) {
		$chips[] = [
			'label' => sprintf(
				/* translators: %s: search query */
				__( 'Keyword: %s', 'listingcore-theme' ),
				sanitize_text_field( $get['s'] )
			),
			'url'   => listingcore_theme_results_url( [ 's' => null ] ),
		];
	}

	if ( ! empty( $get['cat'] ) ) {
		$term = get_term( (int) $get['cat'], 'category' );
		if ( $term && ! is_wp_error( $term ) ) {
			$chips[] = [
				'label' => sprintf(
					/* translators: %s: category name */
					__( 'Category: %s', 'listingcore-theme' ),
					$term->name
				),
				'url'   => listingcore_theme_results_url( [ 'cat' => null ] ),
			];
		}
	}

	if ( ! empty( $get['listingcore_location'] ) ) {
		$chips[] = [
			'label' => sprintf(
				/* translators: %s: location query */
				__( 'Location: %s', 'listingcore-theme' ),
				sanitize_text_field( $get['listingcore_location'] )
			),
			'url'   => listingcore_theme_results_url( [ 'listingcore_location' => null ] ),
		];
	}

	$min = isset( $get['min_price'] ) ? sanitize_text_field( $get['min_price'] ) : '';
	$max = isset( $get['max_price'] ) ? sanitize_text_field( $get['max_price'] ) : '';
	if ( '' !== $min || '' !== $max ) {
		$chips[] = [
			'label' => sprintf(
				/* translators: 1: min price, 2: max price */
				__( 'Price: %1$s – %2$s', 'listingcore-theme' ),
				'' !== $min ? $min : '—',
				'' !== $max ? $max : '—'
			),
			'url'   => listingcore_theme_results_url(
				[
					'min_price' => null,
					'max_price' => null,
				]
			),
		];
	}

	return $chips;
}

/**
 * Native categories for selectors and category cards.
 *
 * @param array $args get_categories args.
 * @return WP_Term[]
 */
function listingcore_theme_get_category_items( $args = [] ) {
	$categories = get_categories(
		wp_parse_args(
			$args,
			[
				'taxonomy'   => 'category',
				'hide_empty' => true,
				'number'     => 8,
			]
		)
	);

	if ( is_wp_error( $categories ) || empty( $categories ) ) {
		return [];
	}

	/**
	 * Filter category presentation items.
	 *
	 * @param WP_Term[] $categories Terms.
	 */
	return apply_filters( 'listingcore_theme_category_items', $categories );
}

/**
 * Location presentation items. Empty unless a plugin/filter supplies them.
 *
 * @return array<int, array{name: string, url?: string, count?: int, image_id?: int, icon?: string}>
 */
function listingcore_theme_get_location_items() {
	/**
	 * Filter location cards. Return an empty array when no location data exists.
	 *
	 * @param array $items Location items.
	 */
	$items = apply_filters( 'listingcore_theme_location_items', [] );

	return is_array( $items ) ? $items : [];
}

/**
 * Whether favorite controls should be interactive.
 *
 * @param array $item Listing item.
 * @return bool
 */
function listingcore_theme_favorite_enabled( $item = [] ) {
	/**
	 * Filter favorite control availability.
	 *
	 * @param bool  $enabled Whether favorites are available.
	 * @param array $item    Listing item.
	 */
	return (bool) apply_filters( 'listingcore_theme_favorite_enabled', false, $item );
}

/**
 * Apply native sort query vars on the main loop.
 *
 * @param WP_Query $query Query.
 */
function listingcore_theme_pre_get_posts( $query ) {
	if ( is_admin() || ! $query->is_main_query() ) {
		return;
	}

	if ( ! $query->is_home() && ! $query->is_search() && ! $query->is_archive() ) {
		return;
	}

	if ( isset( $_GET['orderby'] ) ) { // phpcs:ignore WordPress.Security.NonceVerification.Recommended
		$query->set( 'orderby', listingcore_theme_get_orderby() );
		$query->set( 'order', listingcore_theme_get_order() );
	}
}
add_action( 'pre_get_posts', 'listingcore_theme_pre_get_posts' );

<timestamp>Friday, Sep 18, 2026, 7:58 AM (UTC+5:30)</timestamp>
<user_query>
PHASE 1 FOUNDATION IS APPROVED.

Now begin PHASE 2: CLASSIFIEDS / DIRECTORY PRESENTATION SYSTEM.

This is the first major product/UI phase.

Our goal is to make the theme feel like a mature, premium classifieds/directory product with UX quality comparable to established commercial themes such as Classima.

DO NOT copy Classima's code, assets, branding, or proprietary implementation.

Build our own implementation using the existing ListingCore design language.

==================================================
NON-NEGOTIABLE ARCHITECTURE
===========================

The theme MUST remain functional with ZERO plugins.

Do NOT:

* register a listing CPT
* register listing taxonomies
* recreate ListingCore business logic
* recreate payment processing
* require ListingCore
* require WooCommerce
* require Elementor
* add TGM
* add plugin installation prompts
* add mandatory shortcodes
* add plugin-specific database tables
* add plugin-specific business logic

The theme owns PRESENTATION.

The ListingCore plugin may later provide DATA/FUNCTIONALITY.

Therefore design the presentation layer so it can consume WordPress-native content now and ListingCore data later through clean optional integration.

==================================================
FIRST TASK — AUDIT EXISTING LISTING STYLES
==========================================

Before coding, inspect the existing CSS and template files.

There are already substantial styles for:

* listing cards
* listing grids
* filters
* hero
* dashboard
* CTA
* badges
* metadata
* responsive layouts

Do NOT throw this work away.

Determine:

1. Which existing styles are reusable.
2. Which are incomplete.
3. Which are inconsistent.
4. Which selectors are orphaned.
5. Which components need markup.
6. Which components need CSS refinement.

Create a component inventory before implementation.

Then proceed.

==================================================
PHASE 2A — LISTING CARD SYSTEM
==============================

Build a canonical reusable listing-card presentation system.

The card should support:

* image
* image fallback
* featured badge
* category badge
* title
* price
* location
* key metadata
* date
* seller/avatar where available
* favorite control presentation
* optional verification badge
* optional promoted badge

The card must have clear visual hierarchy:

IMAGE
↓
BADGES
↓
TITLE
↓
PRICE
↓
LOCATION / METADATA
↓
SELLER / DATE / ACTIONS

Do not overcrowd the card.

Support:

* grid card
* horizontal/list card

Do not create separate unrelated card systems.

Create one canonical component structure with modifiers.

Cards must remain attractive when:

* title is very long
* price is missing
* image is missing
* location is missing
* seller is missing
* metadata is incomplete

==================================================
PHASE 2B — IMAGE SYSTEM
=======================

Create a consistent listing image presentation system.

Use the existing image sizes where appropriate:

* listing-grid
* listing-single
* blog-thumb

The reserved sizes may now be evaluated:

* listing-thumb
* listing-hero
* category-icon
* avatar

Only keep/register sizes that have a genuine presentation use.

Implement:

* aspect-ratio
* object-fit
* graceful placeholder
* lazy loading where appropriate
* responsive image support through WordPress APIs

Do not manually generate unnecessary image URLs.

==================================================
PHASE 2C — LISTING GRID
=======================

Create a reusable listing-grid component.

Support:

* 1 column mobile
* 2 columns where appropriate
* 3 columns desktop
* optional 4-column layout for suitable contexts

Do not force 4 columns when cards become too narrow.

Grid must have consistent:

* gaps
* card heights
* image ratios
* alignment

Test mentally and through CSS at:

360px
390px
414px
768px
1024px
1280px
1440px

==================================================
PHASE 2D — LISTING LIST VIEW
============================

Create a polished horizontal/list presentation.

It should support:

* thumbnail
* title
* price
* location
* metadata
* seller/date
* badges
* favorite/action

Ensure it collapses gracefully on mobile.

Do not create a separate duplicate data model.

==================================================
PHASE 2E — LISTING DETAIL PRESENTATION
======================================

Create the visual presentation layer for a future/supplied listing detail page.

Design:

* breadcrumb
* title
* price
* location
* metadata
* image gallery
* main image
* thumbnails
* description
* seller card
* contact CTA
* favorite CTA
* share CTA
* related listings
* sidebar where appropriate

IMPORTANT:

Do not create the listing CPT.

Do not create ListingCore business logic.

If no listing plugin is installed, do not produce a broken listing detail template.

Build reusable presentation components that can later be connected to ListingCore.

==================================================
PHASE 2F — SEARCH EXPERIENCE
============================

Create a polished classified search presentation.

The search area should support UI for:

* keyword
* category
* location
* price minimum
* price maximum
* additional filters
* search button
* reset
* sorting

The design should work as:

DESKTOP:
horizontal/structured search panel

MOBILE:
compact search + filter drawer

Do not make the theme responsible for processing plugin-specific filter parameters.

Where possible, use normal GET forms and semantic controls.

==================================================
PHASE 2G — FILTER DRAWER
========================

Build a reusable mobile filter drawer.

Requirements:

* accessible
* keyboard usable
* Escape closes
* focus returns to trigger
* overlay
* body scroll management
* correct aria-expanded
* correct aria-controls
* no focus trap bugs

Reuse the accessibility patterns established in Phase 1.

Do not duplicate the mobile-menu JavaScript unnecessarily.

Create reusable utilities where appropriate.

==================================================
PHASE 2H — SORTING / RESULT TOOLBAR
===================================

Create a polished results toolbar.

Support presentation for:

* result count
* sorting
* grid/list switch
* filter trigger
* active filter indicators

The toolbar must gracefully handle missing result counts.

Do not invent numbers.

==================================================
PHASE 2I — CATEGORIES
=====================

Create a category presentation system.

Support:

* category cards
* category icon/image
* category name
* optional count
* hover/focus state

Counts must only be shown when actual data is available.

Design categories so they can later consume ListingCore taxonomy data.

Do not register a taxonomy in the theme.

==================================================
PHASE 2J — LOCATIONS
====================

Create a location discovery presentation system.

Support:

* location cards
* location name
* optional listing count
* optional image
* optional icon

Again:

Do not create a theme-owned location database.

The theme should only provide presentation.

==================================================
PHASE 2K — HERO SEARCH
======================

Refine the homepage hero into a professional classifieds search experience.

Use the existing:

* hero_title
* hero_subtitle

Customizer settings.

Provide:

* prominent search field
* category selector presentation
* location selector presentation
* search CTA

The design must be excellent on mobile.

Do not hard-code ListingCore taxonomy data.

Use sensible WordPress-native fallbacks when no classified plugin exists.

==================================================
PHASE 2L — FEATURED / LATEST CONTENT
====================================

Create reusable sections for:

* Featured Listings presentation
* Latest Listings presentation
* Latest Posts

When no listing plugin exists:

Do not invent fake classified listings.

Use WordPress-native posts or display an intentional empty state.

When ListingCore integration is later added, the same presentation components should be usable.

==================================================
PHASE 2M — CTA COMPONENT
========================

Refine the existing CTA component.

It should support:

* title
* description
* primary CTA
* secondary CTA where appropriate
* responsive layout

It must remain useful without any plugin.

==================================================
PHASE 2N — EMPTY STATES
=======================

Create polished reusable empty states for:

* no search results
* no listings
* no category results
* no favorites
* no dashboard listings
* no image
* generic content unavailable

Empty states should be informative, not visually broken.

==================================================
PHASE 2O — BADGES
=================

Create a consistent badge system.

Support presentation for:

* Featured
* Promoted
* Verified
* New
* Category
* Status

Do not imply verification unless actual data says the entity is verified.

Do not invent listing status.

==================================================
PHASE 2P — FAVORITE / ACTION CONTROLS
=====================================

Create the visual component for:

* favorite
* share
* contact
* save/search action

These should be presentation-ready.

If functionality requires ListingCore, WooCommerce, or another plugin, keep the control safely inert or provide a graceful fallback.

Do not create fake functionality.

==================================================
PHASE 2Q — SELLER CARD
======================

Create a reusable seller profile card presentation.

Support:

* avatar
* name
* member information where available
* verification state where available
* contact CTA
* view listings CTA

Do not expose private information automatically.

Do not create user-management business logic.

==================================================
PHASE 2R — RESPONSIVE QUALITY
=============================

Every new component must be designed mobile-first.

Explicitly test CSS logic for:

360px
390px
414px
768px
1024px
1280px
1440px+

Pay particular attention to:

* card titles
* prices
* buttons
* filter controls
* search controls
* badges
* images
* long text
* sidebar collapse

No horizontal overflow.

==================================================
PHASE 2S — PERFORMANCE
======================

Do not add unnecessary JavaScript.

Prefer CSS for:

* layout
* hover
* transitions
* simple visual states

JavaScript should only handle actual interaction.

Use event delegation where appropriate.

Do not load scripts on pages where they are unnecessary.

Do not add external libraries.

==================================================
PHASE 2T — ACCESSIBILITY
========================

All new components must satisfy:

* keyboard navigation
* visible focus
* semantic headings
* correct button/link semantics
* meaningful labels
* screen-reader support
* reduced-motion support
* appropriate ARIA

Do not use:

aria-hidden="true"

to hide interactive content.

Do not use tabindex="-1" on real interactive controls.

==================================================
PHASE 2U — CSS ARCHITECTURE
===========================

Use the canonical --listingcore-* design token system from Phase 1.

Do NOT introduce:

--color-*
--space-*
--text-*

Do not create a second token system.

Organize components logically.

Avoid:

* duplicate selectors
* excessive specificity
* !important
* inline styles
* dead CSS

Before deleting old listing CSS, verify whether the upcoming components can use it.

==================================================
PHASE 2V — TEMPLATE ARCHITECTURE
================================

Use reusable template parts.

For example, where appropriate:

template-parts/listing/

with components such as:

* card.php
* card-list.php
* gallery.php
* seller.php
* meta.php
* badges.php
* empty.php

Do not create files merely to follow this example.

Use the cleanest structure for the existing theme.

==================================================
PHASE 2W — OPTIONAL LISTINGCORE BRIDGE
======================================

Do NOT implement the actual ListingCore plugin integration yet.

However, structure the presentation layer so that a later optional bridge can supply:

* listing title
* price
* image
* location
* category
* metadata
* seller
* status
* featured state

The presentation component should not care where the data came from.

Keep data mapping separate from presentation.

==================================================
IMPORTANT — NO FAKE DATA
========================

Never hard-code fake:

* listing counts
* prices
* sellers
* locations
* verification
* ratings
* listing statuses

Use real WordPress data when available.

Otherwise use:

* empty state
* placeholder
* optional content

Do not make the theme appear to have a marketplace database when none exists.

==================================================
QUALITY GATES
=============

After implementation:

1. php -l every PHP file.
2. Verify theme.json parses.
3. Verify all template parts exist.
4. Verify all get_template_part references resolve.
5. Verify all require/include references resolve.
6. Search for:

   * register_post_type
   * register_taxonomy
   * do_shortcode
   * add_shortcode
   * tgmpa
   * class-tgm
   * is_plugin_active
   * plugin-install.php
7. Confirm zero mandatory plugin dependency.
8. Confirm WooCommerce remains optional.
9. Confirm Elementor remains optional.
10. Confirm no external font requests.
11. Confirm no horizontal-overflow hacks.
12. Confirm reduced-motion behavior.
13. Confirm keyboard accessibility.
14. Confirm no fake marketplace data.
15. Confirm all new user-visible strings use the listingcore-theme text domain.
16. Regenerate POT.

Do NOT create the final ZIP.

Do NOT begin Phase 3.

At the end report:

* components created
* files added
* files modified
* files removed
* existing CSS reused
* new CSS added
* JavaScript added/changed
* accessibility improvements
* responsive improvements
* performance considerations
* optional ListingCore integration points prepared
* remaining limitations

Then STOP.
</user_query>

I'll review the remaining CSS, helpers, and a few template gaps before running quality gates.
I’ll close the remaining presentation gaps—grid columns, drawer dialog semantics, optional contact CTA, and blog-index toolbar—then run the quality gates.

content.text:
Phase 2 is complete. The theme still owns presentation only. No listing CPT, taxonomies, plugin prompts, or marketplace business logic were added.

## Component inventory (before coding)

**Reusable (kept and extended)**
- Listing card shell, thumbnail, title, facts, excerpt
- Listing grids and category grids
- Filter form, fieldset, range, reset
- Hero, CTA, badges, empty states
- Listing detail/gallery/meta/contact styles
- Dashboard CSS (unused in templates, retained)

**Incomplete**
- No list-card modifier
- No results toolbar, filter drawer, or classified search panel
- No seller, category, or location card markup
- No favorite/share/contact presentation
- Missing image placeholder file; CSS placeholder now used instead
- Grid used `auto-fill`, which could become too narrow at 4+ columns

**Inconsistent**
- Price lived in facts chips instead of a clear hierarchy
- Hero search used a different form than results filters
- Featured was a fact chip, not a badge system

**Orphaned (kept, not deleted)**
- `.listingcore-inline-search-form` / `.listingcore-search-field`
- `.listingcore-listing-card__link` arrow
- `.listingcore-hero__trust`
- `.listingcore-dashboard*`
- `.listingcore-filters__count`

## Phase 2A–2W delivered

One canonical card: `.listingcore-listing-card` with `--grid` / `--list`. Data is mapped in `listingcore_theme_get_listing_item()` and filtered later. Missing price, image, location, seller, or meta simply omit those rows.

## Quality gates

1. `php -l` — all PHP files clean  
2. `theme.json` parses  
3. All listing template parts exist  
4. All `get_template_part` paths resolve (`content.php` is the post-type fallback)  
5. All `require_once` modules exist  
6. No `register_post_type`, `register_taxonomy`, `do_shortcode`, `add_shortcode`, `tgmpa`, `class-tgm`, `is_plugin_active`, or `plugin-install.php`  
7–9. Zero required plugins; WooCommerce and Elementor remain optional  
10. No external font requests  
11. No `overflow-x: hidden`  
12. Reduced-motion covered for cards, categories, locations, drawer  
13. Filter drawer: dialog, Escape, overlay, focus return, `aria-expanded` / `aria-controls`, body scroll lock  
14. No fake prices, sellers, locations, verification, ratings, or counts  
15. New strings use `listingcore-theme`  
16. POT regenerated  

## Report

**Components created**
- Listing card (grid + list)
- Image placeholder / WP image sizes
- Listing grid (1 / 2 / 3, optional 4 at 1440px)
- List view
- Listing detail (template part only; used when `listingcore_theme_is_listing` is true)
- Search panel (hero + results)
- Filter drawer
- Results toolbar
- Category cards
- Location cards
- Hero search
- Featured / latest / latest posts
- CTA
- Empty states
- Badges
- Favorite / share / contact (inert or hidden without data)
- Seller card

**Files added**
- `inc/listing-presentation.php`
- `assets/css/listings.css`
- `template-parts/listing/card.php`
- `template-parts/listing/badges.php`
- `template-parts/listing/empty.php`
- `template-parts/listing/search-panel.php`
- `template-parts/listing/filters.php`
- `template-parts/listing/toolbar.php`
- `template-parts/listing/filter-drawer.php`
- `template-parts/listing/category-card.php`
- `template-parts/listing/location-card.php`
- `template-parts/listing/seller.php`
- `template-parts/listing/gallery.php`
- `template-parts/listing/detail.php`
- `template-parts/listing/cta.php`

**Files modified**
- `functions.php`, `inc/theme-setup.php`, `inc/enqueue.php`, `inc/template-functions.php`, `inc/customizer.php`, `inc/widgets.php`
- `front-page.php`, `archive.php`, `search.php`, `index.php`, `single.php`, `sidebar.php`
- `assets/js/main.js`, `rtl.css`, `languages/listingcore-theme.pot`

**Files removed**
- None in Phase 2

**Existing CSS reused**
- Card, grid, filters, hero, CTA, badges, empty state, listing detail/gallery, dashboard (retained)

**New CSS added**
- `listings.css`: grid breakpoints, list card, toolbar, drawer, search panel, category/location/seller, gallery thumbs, reduced-motion, 414px packing

**JavaScript added/changed**
- Reusable drawers (not a second mobile-menu copy)
- Gallery thumb swap
- Share (Web Share API, clipboard fallback)
- Strip empty GET fields; sort autosubmit

**Accessibility**
- Filter dialog: Escape, overlay, focus trap, restored focus, `aria-modal`
- Semantic headings, labels, `aria-pressed` gallery thumbs
- Share announces “Link copied”
- Decorative `aria-hidden` only

**Responsive**
- Cards: 1 col → 2 from 640px → 3 from 1024px; sidebar layouts stay 2-col until 1280px
- Optional 4-col only with `.listingcore-grid--four` at 1440px+
- List cards stack on small screens
- Mobile filter drawer; desktop sidebar filters
- Hero/results search is 3 fields from 768px; full-width CTA at ≤414px

**Performance**
- No new libraries
- CSS for layout/hover; JS only for interaction
- Lazy images; gallery main is eager
- `listings.css` after `style.css`; no extra script handle

**ListingCore integration points prepared (not implemented)**
- `listingcore_theme_listing_item`
- `listingcore_theme_is_listing` (default `false`)
- `listingcore_theme_listing_card_post_types` (default `post`)
- `listingcore_theme_category_items`
- `listingcore_theme_location_items` (default `[]`)
- `listingcore_theme_favorite_enabled` (default `false`)
- DTO fields ready: price, location, featured, promoted, verified, status, meta, contact_url, seller

**Remaining limitations**
- Without a listing plugin, cards render WordPress posts; price/location/promoted/verified stay empty
- Listing detail does not run for normal blog posts
- Locations section is omitted unless a filter supplies items
- Featured uses sticky posts only
- `min_price`, `max_price`, and `listingcore_location` are GET passthroughs, not queried
- Favorite/contact stay hidden until a plugin supplies behavior or a URL
- Some pre-Phase-2 selectors remain unused on purpose (old hero search, dashboard)
- `listing-hero` image size was dropped; no live browser pass (no running WordPress site in this workspace)

Phase 3 was not started. No ZIP was created.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Extract listingcore-theme gettext strings into languages/listingcore-theme.pot."""
from __future__ import annotations

import datetime
import os
import re
from collections import OrderedDict
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
OUT = ROOT / "languages" / "listingcore-theme.pot"
DOMAIN = "listingcore-theme"

PATTERN = re.compile(
    r"""(?P<fn>__|_e|_x|_ex|_n|_nx|esc_html__|esc_html_e|esc_attr__|esc_attr_e|esc_html_x|esc_attr_x)\s*\(\s*(?P<q>['"])(?P<str>(?:\\.|[^\\])*?)(?P=q)(?:\s*,\s*(?P<q2>['"])(?P<str2>(?:\\.|[^\\])*?)(?P=q2))?\s*,\s*(?P<qd>['"])listingcore-theme(?P=qd)""",
    re.S,
)

SKIP_DIRS = {".git", "node_modules", "vendor", "tools"}


def unescape(s: str) -> str:
    return bytes(s, "utf-8").decode("unicode_escape") if "\\" in s else s


def php_files() -> list[Path]:
    files = []
    for dirpath, dirnames, filenames in os.walk(ROOT):
        dirnames[:] = [d for d in dirnames if d not in SKIP_DIRS]
        for name in filenames:
            if name.endswith(".php"):
                files.append(Path(dirpath) / name)
    return sorted(files)


def extract() -> OrderedDict[str, list[str]]:
    grouped: OrderedDict[str, list[str]] = OrderedDict()
    for path in php_files():
        text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        rel = path.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()
        for match in PATTERN.finditer(text):
            line = text.count("\n", 0, match.start()) + 1
            msgid = unescape(match.group("str"))
            msgid2 = unescape(match.group("str2") or "")
            key = msgid if not msgid2 else msgid + "\0" + msgid2
            grouped.setdefault(key, []).append(f"{rel}:{line}")
    return grouped


def pot_escape(s: str) -> str:
    return s.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace('"', '\\"').replace("\n", "\\n")


def wrap_msgid(label: str, s: str) -> str:
    if "\n" in s or len(s) > 70:
        lines = [f'{label} ""']
        # Keep as a single quoted line if no real newlines.
        if "\n" not in s:
            lines.append(f'"{pot_escape(s)}"')
            return "\n".join(lines)
        parts = s.split("\n")
        for i, part in enumerate(parts):
            suffix = "\\n" if i < len(parts) - 1 else ""
            lines.append(f'"{pot_escape(part)}{suffix}"')
        return "\n".join(lines)
    return f'{label} "{pot_escape(s)}"'


def main() -> None:
    grouped = extract()
    now = datetime.datetime.utcnow().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M+0000")
    header = f"""# Copyright (C) 2026 virendrasingh06
# This file is distributed under the GNU General Public License v2 or later.
msgid ""
msgstr ""
"Project-Id-Version: ListingCore Theme 1.0.0\\n"
"Report-Msgid-Bugs-To: https://wordpress.org/support/theme/listingcore-theme\\n"
"POT-Creation-Date: {now}\\n"
"MIME-Version: 1.0\\n"
"Content-Type: text/plain; charset=UTF-8\\n"
"Content-Transfer-Encoding: 8bit\\n"
"PO-Revision-Date: YEAR-MO-DA HO:MI+ZONE\\n"
"Last-Translator: FULL NAME <EMAIL@ADDRESS>\\n"
"Language-Team: LANGUAGE <LL@li.org>\\n"
"Plural-Forms: nplurals=INTEGER; plural=EXPRESSION;\\n"
"X-Generator: ListingCore Theme potgen\\n"
"X-Domain: {DOMAIN}\\n"
"""
    chunks = [header]
    for key, refs in grouped.items():
        chunks.append("")
        for ref in refs:
            chunks.append(f"#: {ref}")
        if "\0" in key:
            singular, plural = key.split("\0", 1)
            chunks.append(wrap_msgid("msgid", singular))
            chunks.append(wrap_msgid("msgid_plural", plural))
            chunks.append('msgstr[0] ""')
            chunks.append('msgstr[1] ""')
        else:
            chunks.append(wrap_msgid("msgid", key))
            chunks.append('msgstr ""')
    OUT.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    OUT.write_text("\n".join(chunks) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    print(f"Wrote {len(grouped)} strings")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

Phase 2.5 is complete. Phase 3 was not started.

## Architecture
Presentation still follows **source → normalize → templates**. Shared search fields live in `template-parts/listing/fields.php`. Filter state is a request-scoped contract (`keyword`, `category`, `location`, `min_price`, `max_price`, `sort`, `view`, `applied`, `counts`). Location and price remain GET values only; `listingcore_theme_apply_listing_filters` is the provider hook. Sort can be hidden via `listingcore_theme_sort_enabled`.

## Data contract
Canonical item shape is `listingcore_theme_default_listing_item()` / `listingcore_theme_normalize_listing_item()`. Missing fields stay empty and are omitted in markup. Templates consume the DTO, not post/plugin internals. Escape happens at output.

## UI polish
Price is a primary value. Card hierarchy is image → badges → title → price → location → meta → seller/date, with one stretched permalink. List cards stack below 768px. Empty states cover search, listings, category, location, seller, and favorites; CTAs render only with a real URL. Unavailable favorites are disabled, not fake controls.

## Accessibility
One drawer utility: focus trap, Escape, overlay, `aria-expanded` / `aria-controls` / `aria-modal`, return focus, body scroll restore, mutual close with the mobile menu. Gallery thumbs are buttons with `aria-pressed`. Grid/list uses `aria-pressed` plus GET persistence. Share success uses `aria-live`.

## CSS
Removed the unused `.listingcore-listings-grid` duplicate from `listings.css`. Tokens remain `--listingcore-*` only. `color-scheme: light` is set so the theme does not inherit unreadable dark form controls. No `overflow-x: hidden` workaround.

## JavaScript
Existing IIFE modules kept. Share copy only marks success when clipboard/`execCommand` actually succeeds. Pages without drawers/gallery/share do not throw.

## Responsive
CSS audited for 360 / 390 / 414 / 768 / 1024 / 1280 / 1440: hero search full-width submit on small phones, toolbar wrap, list-card stacking, 1/2/3 listing columns. Live viewport pass was not run here (no WordPress runtime).

## Security
GET keys sanitized; DTO values escaped at echo (`esc_html`, `esc_attr`, `esc_url`). Customizer sanitizers unchanged.

## Performance
Filter state and category lists are request-cached. Images use WordPress size APIs; main gallery image is eager, thumbs lazy. Related query uses `no_found_rows`.

## Image sizes
**Kept:** `listingcore-listing-grid`, `listingcore-listing-thumb`, `listingcore-listing-single`, `listingcore-blog-thumb`, `listingcore-category-icon`, `listingcore-avatar`.  
**Removed earlier and still gone:** `listingcore-listing-hero`.

## Quality gates
`php -l` all PHP files, `theme.json` valid, `require`/`get_template_part` paths resolve, POT regenerated (215 strings). Absent: `register_post_type`, `register_taxonomy`, shortcodes, TGM, `is_plugin_active`, `plugin-install.php`, `fonts.googleapis.com`.

## Remaining limitations
- Location and price do not change the WP query until a data provider sets `applied` and filters the query.
- `listingcore_theme_is_listing` still defaults to false; singles stay blog posts unless a provider opts in.
- No listing CPT, taxonomies, payments, favorites backend, or ListingCore integration.
- Location cards stay empty unless `listingcore_theme_location_items` supplies them.
- No lightbox, no schema, no dark-mode design system.
- Unused `.listingcore-card` / `.listingcore-listings-grid` rules remain in `style.css` as optional-integration leftovers; they were not merged blindly.

STOP.
