Create a reusable account navigation component.

Potential destinations:

* Dashboard
* My Listings
* Add Listing
* Profile
* Favorites
* Messages if supplied later
* Logout

Do not show destinations that have no real URL/functionality unless they are explicitly marked unavailable.

Account navigation must work on:

* desktop
* tablet
* mobile

Mobile account navigation must not conflict with the existing mobile menu/drawer utility.

==================================================
3C — DASHBOARD PRESENTATION
===========================

Build a polished dashboard shell.

The dashboard should contain:

HEADER

* page title
* welcome/user identity where available
* avatar

SUMMARY

* Active listings
* Pending listings
* Draft listings
* Expired listings if available

NAVIGATION

* My Listings
* Add Listing
* Profile
* Favorites

MAIN CONTENT

* context-dependent panel

SIDEBAR/navigation should collapse appropriately on mobile.

Do not invent listing counts.

If counts are unavailable:

* omit them
* or show a neutral unavailable state

Never display fake zeroes merely to fill UI.

==================================================
3D — MY LISTINGS
================

Create the presentation system for a user's listings.

Support:

* listing thumbnail
* title
* price
* location
* status
* date
* views if supplied
* actions

Actions may include:

* View
* Edit
* Publish
* Unpublish
* Delete/Trash

IMPORTANT:

Do not implement the business operation unless WordPress itself can safely perform it.

Prepare action URLs/hooks for a future ListingCore provider.

Each destructive action must eventually support:

* nonce
* ownership check
* confirmation

Do not create fake action buttons.

==================================================
3E — LISTING STATUS SYSTEM
==========================

Create a reusable status presentation component.

Possible states:

* Published
* Pending
* Draft
* Expired
* Sold
* Rejected
* Archived

Only display statuses actually supplied by the data provider.

Use consistent badge styling.

Do not infer status from arbitrary text.

==================================================
3F — ADD LISTING PRESENTATION
=============================

Create a polished multi-step "Post a Listing" interface.

Suggested structure:

STEP 1
Category

STEP 2
Basic information

STEP 3
Location

STEP 4
Price

STEP 5
Description

STEP 6
Images

STEP 7
Contact information

STEP 8
Preview

STEP 9
Submit

This is PRESENTATION ONLY.

Do not create a listing CPT.

Do not save listings.

Do not invent a database.

Create a clean provider contract so a future plugin can supply:

* fields
* validation
* save action
* upload handling
* categories
* locations
* submission URL
* success URL

==================================================
3G — FORM COMPONENT SYSTEM
==========================

Create reusable form presentation components.

Support:

* text
* email
* number
* textarea
* select
* checkbox
* radio
* file/image presentation
* price
* location
* grouped fields
* required indicator
* help text
* error message
* success message

Ensure consistent:

* labels
* spacing
* focus states
* errors
* disabled states
* required indicators

Use semantic HTML.

Do not use placeholder text as the only label.

==================================================
3H — FORM VALIDATION PRESENTATION
=================================

Build UI states for:

* required field missing
* invalid email
* invalid number
* invalid price
* invalid image
* upload error
* server error
* success

The theme must not claim a form was successfully submitted unless the provider/backend confirms success.

==================================================
3I — IMAGE UPLOAD PRESENTATION
==============================

Create an image uploader UI for the future listing submission workflow.

Support presentation for:

* drag/drop area
* browse button
* thumbnail preview
* primary image
* remove
* reorder
* upload progress
* error
* empty state

Do not implement server-side media processing.

Use progressive enhancement.

Without JavaScript, the underlying form should remain understandable.

==================================================
3J — LISTING PREVIEW
====================

Create a preview presentation component.

It should reuse the SAME listing card/detail components created in Phase 2.

Do not create a second visual system.

Preview should support:

* title
* price
* images
* location
* metadata
* description
* seller

Use normalized DTO data.

==================================================
3K — EDIT LISTING
=================

Create presentation for editing an existing listing.

Reuse the Add Listing form components.

Do not duplicate the entire form.

The difference between ADD and EDIT should primarily be:

* supplied data
* action
* heading
* button text
* provider behavior

==================================================
3L — PROFILE
============

Create a polished profile page.

Support:

* avatar
* display name
* first/last name
* email
* phone where supplied
* website
* bio
* password-change presentation

IMPORTANT:

Do not expose private account information publicly.

Separate:

ACCOUNT PROFILE
from
PUBLIC SELLER PROFILE

where appropriate.

==================================================
3M — PUBLIC SELLER PROFILE
==========================

Create a reusable public seller profile presentation.

Support:

* avatar
* seller name
* bio
* verification if supplied
* member information if supplied
* listings
* contact CTA if supplied

Do not expose:

* password
* private email
* private account metadata
* security information

unless the data provider explicitly exposes it as public.

==================================================
3N — FAVORITES
==============

Create the Favorites page presentation.

Support:

* saved listing cards
* empty state
* remove action
* pagination if provider supplies it

IMPORTANT:

Do not create a favorites database.

Do not create fake saved listings.

Define a future provider interface for:

* is_favorited
* favorite_url
* unfavorite_url
* favorite_items

If no provider exists, show an intentional empty state.

==================================================
3O — LOGIN STATE IN HEADER
==========================

Refine the header account controls.

Logged out:

* Log in
* Register where appropriate
* Post Listing CTA

Logged in:

* Avatar
* Dashboard
* Post Listing
* Logout

Do not expose admin-only links to ordinary users.

Use WordPress capability checks where relevant.

==================================================
3P — POST LISTING CTA
=====================

Create a consistent Post a Listing CTA across:

* header
* hero
* dashboard
* empty states
* CTA sections

Do not scatter hard-coded URLs.

Create one theme-level URL resolver/filter.

A future ListingCore provider can override the destination.

==================================================
3Q — NOTICES
============

Create reusable notices for:

* success
* error
* warning
* information

They must support:

* semantic markup
* accessible announcement where appropriate
* dismiss control where appropriate
* keyboard accessibility

Do not rely solely on color.

==================================================
3R — CONFIRMATION UI
====================

Create reusable confirmation presentation for destructive actions.

Examples:

* delete listing
* remove favorite
* unpublish listing

Do not perform destructive actions through GET requests.

The theme may provide confirmation UI while the provider handles the actual operation.

==================================================
3S — DASHBOARD MOBILE UX
========================

At:

360px
390px
414px

ensure:

* dashboard navigation is usable
* tables/listings do not overflow
* actions remain accessible
* forms remain readable
* buttons do not collide
* cards stack appropriately

Avoid horizontal overflow hacks.

For tabular listing management, consider responsive cards instead of forcing a desktop table onto a phone.

==================================================
3T — ACCESSIBILITY
==================

All Phase 3 components must support:

* keyboard navigation
* visible focus
* semantic headings
* labels
* error association
* accessible form controls
* screen-reader announcements
* Escape where appropriate
* focus restoration for dialogs
* reduced motion

Form errors should be associated with their inputs.

Required fields must be communicated accessibly.

Do not use:

aria-hidden="true"

on interactive elements.

==================================================
3U — SECURITY
=============

Even though this is presentation-focused, audit all generated forms.

Ensure:

* escaped output
* sanitized attributes
* safe URLs
* nonce placeholders/hooks where actions are eventually submitted
* capability-aware presentation
* no sensitive information in markup
* no user-controlled HTML without sanitization

Never trust user-provided profile values.

==================================================
3V — PROVIDER CONTRACTS
=======================

Prepare clean hooks/interfaces for future ListingCore integration.

Potential contracts:

listing data
listing status
listing counts
listing form fields
listing submission
listing editing
seller profile
favorites
categories
locations
account URLs
dashboard URLs
post-listing URL

Document contracts clearly.

Do NOT implement ListingCore itself.

==================================================
3W — WORDPRESS ZERO-PLUGIN FALLBACK
===================================

With ZERO plugins:

* theme activates
* homepage works
* posts work
* archives work
* search works
* pages work
* authentication presentation works with WordPress-native mechanisms where applicable
* dashboard does not claim to contain listings that do not exist
* add-listing UI does not pretend to save listings
* favorites do not pretend to save data
* no broken marketplace functionality appears

The theme must remain honest about unavailable functionality.

==================================================
3X — REUSE PHASE 2 COMPONENTS
=============================

Do NOT create duplicate:

* cards
* badges
* empty states
* drawers
* buttons
* notices
* form controls

Reuse the existing design system.

The user experience should feel like ONE product.

==================================================
3Y — PERFORMANCE
================

Avoid unnecessary JavaScript.

Do not add libraries.

Do not load dashboard-specific assets on every page unless necessary.

Use conditional asset loading where practical.

Do not create expensive queries.

==================================================
3Z — QUALITY GATES
==================

Run:

1. php -l on every PHP file
2. theme.json validation
3. template reference validation
4. require/include validation
5. JS syntax validation
6. CSS sanity check

Search for and ensure absence of:

* register_post_type
* register_taxonomy
* do_shortcode
* add_shortcode
* tgmpa
* class-tgm
* is_plugin_active
* plugin-install.php
* fonts.googleapis.com

Confirm:

* zero mandatory plugin dependency
* WooCommerce remains optional
* Elementor remains optional
* no fake listing data
* no fake user data
* no fake counts
* no fake favorites
* no fake submission success
* no destructive GET actions
* no sensitive information leakage

Regenerate POT.

==================================================
IMPORTANT
=========

DO NOT:

* create a listing CPT
* create listing taxonomies
* implement ListingCore
* implement payments
* implement marketplace database logic
* create a final ZIP

PHASE 4 WILL HANDLE THE ACTUAL LISTINGCORE INTEGRATION.

At the end provide:

* dashboard components
* account components
* form components
* seller components
* favorites components
* files added
* files modified
* files removed
* provider contracts created
* accessibility improvements
* security improvements
* performance improvements
* remaining limitations

Then STOP.

Do not begin Phase 4 automatically.

<?php
/**
 * Account, dashboard, and listing-form presentation contracts.
 *
 * Data flow remains: source → normalize → presentation.
 * No CPT, taxonomies, payments, favorites database, or ListingCore logic.
 *
 * @package ListingCoreTheme
 * @since   1.0.0
 */

defined( 'ABSPATH' ) || exit;

/**
 * Allowed dashboard panel keys.
 *
 * @return string[]
 */
function listingcore_theme_account_views() {
	return [ 'dashboard', 'listings', 'add', 'edit', 'profile', 'favorites' ];
}

/**
 * Known listing statuses. Unknown values are not displayed.
 *
 * @return array<string, string>
 */
function listingcore_theme_listing_statuses() {
	return [
		'published' => __( 'Published', 'listingcore-theme' ),
		'pending'   => __( 'Pending', 'listingcore-theme' ),
		'draft'     => __( 'Draft', 'listingcore-theme' ),
		'expired'   => __( 'Expired', 'listingcore-theme' ),
		'sold'      => __( 'Sold', 'listingcore-theme' ),
		'rejected'  => __( 'Rejected', 'listingcore-theme' ),
		'archived'  => __( 'Archived', 'listingcore-theme' ),
	];
}

/**
 * Map a WordPress post_status to a known listing status key.
 *
 * @param string $post_status WP post status.
 * @return string Empty when unknown.
 */
function listingcore_theme_map_post_status( $post_status ) {
	$map = [
		'publish' => 'published',
		'pending' => 'pending',
		'draft'   => 'draft',
		'trash'   => 'archived',
	];

	$key = isset( $map[ $post_status ] ) ? $map[ $post_status ] : '';

	/**
	 * Filter the mapped listing status key for a WP post status.
	 *
	 * @param string $key         Known status key or empty.
	 * @param string $post_status WordPress post status.
	 */
	return (string) apply_filters( 'listingcore_theme_map_post_status', $key, $post_status );
}

/**
 * Normalize a status key. Arbitrary labels are not inferred.
 *
 * @param mixed $status Status key.
 * @return string
 */
function listingcore_theme_normalize_listing_status( $status ) {
	$key      = is_string( $status ) ? sanitize_key( $status ) : '';
	$statuses = listingcore_theme_listing_statuses();

	return isset( $statuses[ $key ] ) ? $key : '';
}

/**
 * First published page using a theme page template.
 *
 * @param string $template Template filename relative to the theme root.
 * @return string URL or empty.
 */
function listingcore_theme_get_template_page_url( $template ) {
	static $cache = [];

	$template = sanitize_file_name( $template );
	if ( '' === $template ) {
		return '';
	}

	if ( array_key_exists( $template, $cache ) ) {
		return $cache[ $template ];
	}

	$pages = get_posts(
		[
			'post_type'              => 'page',
			'post_status'            => 'publish',
			'posts_per_page'         => 1,
			'fields'                 => 'ids',
			'no_found_rows'          => true,
			'update_post_meta_cache' => false,
			'update_post_term_cache' => false,
			'meta_key'               => '_wp_page_template',
			'meta_value'             => $template,
		]
	);

	$cache[ $template ] = ( $pages && isset( $pages[0] ) ) ? (string) get_permalink( (int) $pages[0] ) : '';

	return $cache[ $template ];
}

/**
 * Account and dashboard URLs.
 *
 * Filter: listingcore_theme_account_urls
 *
 * Defaults use WordPress login/register/lost-password URLs and optional
 * theme page templates. Empty values mean the destination is unavailable.
 *
 * @return array<string, string>
 */
function listingcore_theme_get_account_urls() {
	static $urls = null;

	if ( null !== $urls ) {
		return $urls;
	}

	$dashboard = listingcore_theme_get_template_page_url( 'template-dashboard.php' );
	$login     = listingcore_theme_get_template_page_url( 'template-login.php' );
	$register  = listingcore_theme_get_template_page_url( 'template-register.php' );
	$lost      = listingcore_theme_get_template_page_url( 'template-lost-password.php' );

	$urls = [
		'login'         => $login ? $login : wp_login_url( home_url( '/' ) ),
		'register'      => '',
		'lost_password' => $lost ? $lost : wp_lostpassword_url(),
		'logout'        => is_user_logged_in() ? wp_logout_url( home_url( '/' ) ) : '',
		'dashboard'     => $dashboard,
		'listings'      => '',
		'add_listing'   => '',
		'edit_listing'  => '',
		'profile'       => '',
		'favorites'     => '',
		'messages'      => '',
		'seller'        => '',
	];

	if ( get_option( 'users_can_register' ) ) {
		$urls['register'] = $register ? $register : wp_registration_url();
	}

	if ( $dashboard ) {
		$urls['listings']    = add_query_arg( 'account', 'listings', $dashboard );
		$urls['add_listing'] = add_query_arg( 'account', 'add', $dashboard );
		$urls['edit_listing'] = add_query_arg( 'account', 'edit', $dashboard );
		$urls['profile']     = add_query_arg( 'account', 'profile', $dashboard );
		$urls['favorites']   = add_query_arg( 'account', 'favorites', $dashboard );
	}

	if ( is_user_logged_in() ) {
		$urls['seller'] = get_author_posts_url( get_current_user_id() );
	}

	/**
	 * Filter account destination URLs. Empty string hides the destination.
	 *
	 * @param array<string, string> $urls URLs keyed by destination.
	 */
	$urls = apply_filters( 'listingcore_theme_account_urls', $urls );
	$urls = is_array( $urls ) ? $urls : [];

	foreach ( $urls as $key => $value ) {
		$urls[ $key ] = is_string( $value ) ? $value : '';
	}

	return $urls;
}

/**
 * Canonical Post a Listing URL.
 *
 * Filter: listingcore_theme_post_listing_url
 *
 * @return string
 */
function listingcore_theme_post_listing_url() {
	$urls = listingcore_theme_get_account_urls();
	$url  = isset( $urls['add_listing'] ) ? $urls['add_listing'] : '';

	/**
	 * Filter the Post a Listing destination.
	 *
	 * @param string $url Destination URL or empty.
	 */
	return (string) apply_filters( 'listingcore_theme_post_listing_url', $url );
}

/**
 * Current dashboard panel key.
 *
 * @return string
 */
function listingcore_theme_get_account_view() {
	$view = get_query_var( 'account' );
	if ( ! is_string( $view ) || '' === $view ) {
		$view = isset( $_GET['account'] ) ? sanitize_key( wp_unslash( $_GET['account'] ) ) : 'dashboard'; // phpcs:ignore WordPress.Security.NonceVerification.Recommended
	} else {
		$view = sanitize_key( $view );
	}

	return in_array( $view, listingcore_theme_account_views(), true ) ? $view : 'dashboard';
}

/**
 * Item ID for edit/preview routes.
 *
 * @return int
 */
function listingcore_theme_get_account_item_id() {
	$item = get_query_var( 'item' );
	if ( '' === $item || null === $item ) {
		$item = isset( $_GET['item'] ) ? absint( wp_unslash( $_GET['item'] ) ) : 0; // phpcs:ignore WordPress.Security.NonceVerification.Recommended
	}

	return absint( $item );
}

/**
 * Whether the current request is the dashboard page template.
 *
 * @return bool
 */
function listingcore_theme_is_dashboard() {
	return is_page_template( 'template-dashboard.php' );
}

/**
 * Whether account/dashboard assets should load.
 *
 * @return bool
 */
function listingcore_theme_needs_account_assets() {
	if ( listingcore_theme_is_dashboard() ) {
		return true;
	}

	if ( is_page_template( 'template-login.php' ) || is_page_template( 'template-register.php' ) || is_page_template( 'template-lost-password.php' ) ) {
		return true;
	}

	return is_author();
}

/**
 * Account navigation items with real destinations only.
 *
 * Filter: listingcore_theme_account_nav
 *
 * @param string $current Current view key.
 * @return array<int, array{key: string, label: string, url: string, current?: bool, modifier?: string}>
 */
function listingcore_theme_get_account_nav( $current = '' ) {
	$urls    = listingcore_theme_get_account_urls();
	$current = $current ? $current : listingcore_theme_get_account_view();
	$items   = [];

	$map = [
		'dashboard'  => [ 'label' => __( 'Dashboard', 'listingcore-theme' ), 'url' => $urls['dashboard'] ],
		'listings'   => [ 'label' => __( 'My Listings', 'listingcore-theme' ), 'url' => $urls['listings'] ],
		'add'        => [ 'label' => __( 'Add Listing', 'listingcore-theme' ), 'url' => $urls['add_listing'] ],
		'profile'    => [ 'label' => __( 'Profile', 'listingcore-theme' ), 'url' => $urls['profile'] ],
		'favorites'  => [ 'label' => __( 'Favorites', 'listingcore-theme' ), 'url' => $urls['favorites'] ],
		'messages'   => [ 'label' => __( 'Messages', 'listingcore-theme' ), 'url' => $urls['messages'] ],
	];

	foreach ( $map as $key => $item ) {
		if ( '' === $item['url'] ) {
			continue;
		}
		$items[] = [
			'key'      => $key,
			'label'    => $item['label'],
			'url'      => $item['url'],
			'current'  => $current === $key || ( 'dashboard' === $key && 'edit' === $current ),
			'modifier' => 'add' === $key ? 'cta' : '',
		];
	}

	if ( '' !== $urls['logout'] ) {
		$items[] = [
			'key'      => 'logout',
			'label'    => __( 'Log out', 'listingcore-theme' ),
			'url'      => $urls['logout'],
			'current'  => false,
			'modifier' => 'logout',
		];
	}

	/**
	 * Filter account navigation items. Omit items without a real URL.
	 *
	 * @param array  $items   Nav items.
	 * @param string $current Current view.
	 */
	$items = apply_filters( 'listingcore_theme_account_nav', $items, $current );

	return is_array( $items ) ? $items : [];
}

/**
 * Dashboard summary counts. Null means unavailable (omit). Zero is real.
 *
 * Filter: listingcore_theme_dashboard_counts
 *
 * @return array<string, int|null>
 */
function listingcore_theme_get_dashboard_counts() {
	$counts = [
		'active'  => null,
		'pending' => null,
		'draft'   => null,
		'expired' => null,
	];

	/**
	 * Filter dashboard listing counts. Use null when a count is unknown.
	 * Do not invent marketplace totals.
	 *
	 * @param array<string, int|null> $counts Counts.
	 */
	$counts = apply_filters( 'listingcore_theme_dashboard_counts', $counts );
	$counts = is_array( $counts ) ? $counts : [];

	$user_id = get_current_user_id();
	if ( $user_id && current_user_can( 'edit_posts' ) ) {
		$types = listingcore_theme_listing_card_post_types();
		if ( null === $counts['active'] ) {
			$counts['active'] = (int) count_user_posts( $user_id, $types, true );
		}
		foreach ( [ 'pending' => 'pending', 'draft' => 'draft' ] as $key => $status ) {
			if ( null !== $counts[ $key ] ) {
				continue;
			}
			$query = new WP_Query(
				[
					'author'                 => $user_id,
					'post_type'              => $types,
					'post_status'            => $status,
					'posts_per_page'         => 1,
					'fields'                 => 'ids',
					'no_found_rows'          => false,
					'update_post_meta_cache' => false,
					'update_post_term_cache' => false,
				]
			);
			$counts[ $key ] = (int) $query->found_posts;
			wp_reset_postdata();
		}
	}

	foreach ( $counts as $key => $value ) {
		if ( null !== $value && '' !== $value ) {
			$counts[ $key ] = absint( $value );
		} else {
			$counts[ $key ] = null;
		}
	}

	return $counts;
}

/**
 * Dashboard listings for the current user.
 *
 * Filter: listingcore_theme_dashboard_listings
 * Default: the author's WordPress posts when they can edit_posts.
 *
 * @return array<int, array<string, mixed>>
 */
function listingcore_theme_get_dashboard_listings() {
	$items = null;

	/**
	 * Filter the current user's listing rows. Return an array to replace
	 * the WordPress-post fallback. Each item should be a listing DTO plus
	 * optional `views` and `actions`.
	 *
	 * @param array|null $items Listing items or null to use the WP fallback.
	 */
	$items = apply_filters( 'listingcore_theme_dashboard_listings', $items );

	if ( is_array( $items ) ) {
		return array_values( $items );
	}

	$user_id = get_current_user_id();
	if ( ! $user_id || ! current_user_can( 'edit_posts' ) ) {
		return [];
	}

	$query = new WP_Query(
		[
			'author'                 => $user_id,
			'post_type'              => listingcore_theme_listing_card_post_types(),
			'post_status'            => [ 'publish', 'pending', 'draft' ],
			'posts_per_page'         => 20,
			'no_found_rows'          => true,
			'update_post_term_cache' => true,
		]
	);

	$items = [];
	if ( $query->have_posts() ) {
		while ( $query->have_posts() ) {
			$query->the_post();
			$items[] = listingcore_theme_get_dashboard_listing_item();
		}
		wp_reset_postdata();
	}

	return $items;
}

/**
 * Build a dashboard row from the current post, including safe WP actions.
 *
 * @param WP_Post|int|null $post Post.
 * @return array<string, mixed>
 */
function listingcore_theme_get_dashboard_listing_item( $post = null ) {
	$post = get_post( $post );
	$item = listingcore_theme_get_listing_item( $post );

	if ( ! $post ) {
		return $item;
	}

	$item['status'] = listingcore_theme_map_post_status( $post->post_status );
	$item['views']  = null;

	$actions = [];
	if ( $item['url'] ) {
		$actions[] = [
			'key'    => 'view',
			'label'  => __( 'View', 'listingcore-theme' ),
			'url'    => $item['url'],
			'method' => 'get',
		];
	}

	$edit = get_edit_post_link( $post, 'raw' );
	if ( $edit && current_user_can( 'edit_post', $post->ID ) ) {
		$actions[] = [
			'key'    => 'edit',
			'label'  => __( 'Edit', 'listingcore-theme' ),
			'url'    => $edit,
			'method' => 'get',
		];
	}

	if ( current_user_can( 'publish_post', $post->ID ) && 'draft' === $post->post_status ) {
		$actions[] = listingcore_theme_dashboard_post_action( 'publish', $post->ID, __( 'Publish', 'listingcore-theme' ) );
	}

	if ( current_user_can( 'publish_post', $post->ID ) && 'publish' === $post->post_status ) {
		$actions[] = listingcore_theme_dashboard_post_action(
			'unpublish',
			$post->ID,
			__( 'Unpublish', 'listingcore-theme' ),
			__( 'Unpublish this item? It will become a draft.', 'listingcore-theme' )
		);
	}

	if ( current_user_can( 'delete_post', $post->ID ) ) {
		$actions[] = listingcore_theme_dashboard_post_action(
			'trash',
			$post->ID,
			__( 'Move to trash', 'listingcore-theme' ),
			__( 'Move this item to the trash?', 'listingcore-theme' ),
			true
		);
	}

	/**
	 * Filter dashboard actions for a listing row.
	 *
	 * @param array   $actions Actions.
	 * @param array   $item    Listing item.
	 * @param WP_Post $post    Post.
	 */
	$item['actions'] = apply_filters( 'listingcore_theme_dashboard_listing_actions', $actions, $item, $post );

	return $item;
}

/**

		'name'        => 'listingcore_theme_listing_action',

}

/**
 * Public seller presentation. Never includes password or private email.
 *
 * Filter: listingcore_theme_public_seller
 *
 * @param WP_User|int|null $user User.
 * @return array<string, mixed>
 */
function listingcore_theme_get_public_seller( $user = null ) {
	if ( $user instanceof WP_User ) {
		$user_obj = $user;
	} else {
		$user_obj = $user ? get_user_by( 'id', (int) $user ) : null;
	}

	if ( ! $user_obj && is_author() ) {
		$user_obj = get_queried_object();
	}

	if ( ! $user_obj instanceof WP_User ) {
		return [];
	}

	$registered = $user_obj->user_registered;
	$seller     = [
		'id'            => (int) $user_obj->ID,
		'name'          => $user_obj->display_name,
		'url'           => get_author_posts_url( $user_obj->ID ),
		'avatar'        => get_avatar_url( $user_obj->ID, [ 'size' => 96 ] ),
		'avatar_id'     => 0,
		'member'        => $registered
			? sprintf(
				/* translators: %s: membership year */
				__( 'Member since %s', 'listingcore-theme' ),
				mysql2date( 'Y', $registered )
			)
			: '',
		'verified'      => false,
		'listing_url'   => get_author_posts_url( $user_obj->ID ),
		'contact_url'   => '',
		'listing_count' => null,
		'bio'           => $user_obj->description,
		'website'       => $user_obj->user_url,
	];

	/**
	 * Filter public seller data. Do not add private email, passwords,
	 * or security fields unless they are explicitly public.
	 *
	 * @param array   $seller Public seller.
	 * @param WP_User $user   User.
	 */
	$seller = apply_filters( 'listingcore_theme_public_seller', $seller, $user_obj );

	return is_array( $seller ) ? $seller : [];
}

	$profile = apply_filters( 'listingcore_theme_profile', $profile, $user );

}

/**
 * Listing add/edit form contract.
 *
 * Filter: listingcore_theme_listing_form
 * Default: presentation only; can_submit is false until a provider supplies
 * an action URL and enables submission.
 *
 * @param string $mode    add|edit.
 * @param int    $item_id Item ID for edit.
 * @return array<string, mixed>
 */
function listingcore_theme_get_listing_form( $mode = 'add', $item_id = 0 ) {
	$mode    = 'edit' === $mode ? 'edit' : 'add';
	$item_id = absint( $item_id );
	$item    = listingcore_theme_default_listing_item();
	$values  = [];

	if ( 'edit' === $mode && $item_id ) {
		$post = get_post( $item_id );
		if ( $post && (int) $post->post_author === get_current_user_id() && current_user_can( 'edit_post', $item_id ) ) {
			$item   = listingcore_theme_get_listing_item( $post );
			$values = [
				'post_title'              => $item['title'],
				'post_content'            => $post->post_content,
				'cat'                     => ( ! empty( $item['category']['id'] ) ) ? (string) $item['category']['id'] : '',
				'listingcore_location'    => $item['location'],
				'listingcore_price'       => $item['price'],
				'listingcore_contact_name'=> $item['seller']['name'],
			];
			if ( empty( $values['cat'] ) && ! empty( $item['categories'][0]['name'] ) ) {
				$terms = get_the_category( $item_id );
				if ( $terms && ! is_wp_error( $terms ) ) {
					$values['cat'] = (string) $terms[0]->term_id;
				}
			}
		}
	}

	$config = [
		'mode'         => $mode,
		'enabled'      => true,
		'can_submit'   => false,
		'action'       => '',
		'method'       => 'post',
		'enctype'      => 'multipart/form-data',
		'nonce_action' => 'listingcore_theme_listing_submit',
		'nonce_name'   => '_wpnonce',
		'heading'      => 'edit' === $mode ? __( 'Edit listing', 'listingcore-theme' ) : __( 'Post a listing', 'listingcore-theme' ),
		'submit_label' => 'edit' === $mode ? __( 'Save listing', 'listingcore-theme' ) : __( 'Submit listing', 'listingcore-theme' ),
		'success'      => false,
		'notice'       => __( 'This form is a preview of the listing workflow. Submitting is available when a listings provider is connected.', 'listingcore-theme' ),
		'values'       => $values,
		'errors'       => [],
		'steps'        => listingcore_theme_default_listing_form_steps( $mode ),
		'item'         => $item,
		'item_id'      => $item_id,
	];

	/**
	 * Filter the listing form contract.
	 *
	 * A provider may set `can_submit`, `action`, `values`, `errors`, `steps`,
	 * and `success` (only after a confirmed save).
	 *
	 * @param array  $config  Form config.
	 * @param string $mode    add|edit.
	 * @param int    $item_id Item ID.
	 */
	$config = apply_filters( 'listingcore_theme_listing_form', $config, $mode, $item_id );

	return is_array( $config ) ? $config : [];
}

/**
 * Build a preview DTO from form values without saving.
 *
 * @param array $values Form values.
 * @param array $item   Base item.
 * @return array<string, mixed>
 */
function listingcore_theme_preview_listing_item( $values, $item = [] ) {
	$item  = listingcore_theme_normalize_listing_item( $item );
	$values = is_array( $values ) ? $values : [];

	if ( ! empty( $values['post_title'] ) ) {
		$item['title'] = sanitize_text_field( (string) $values['post_title'] );
	}
	if ( ! empty( $values['post_content'] ) ) {
		$item['excerpt'] = wp_trim_words( wp_strip_all_tags( (string) $values['post_content'] ), 24 );
	}
	if ( ! empty( $values['listingcore_location'] ) ) {
		$item['location'] = sanitize_text_field( (string) $values['listingcore_location'] );
	}
	if ( ! empty( $values['listingcore_price'] ) ) {
		$item['price'] = sanitize_text_field( (string) $values['listingcore_price'] );
	}
	if ( ! empty( $values['cat'] ) ) {
		$term = get_term( absint( $values['cat'] ), 'category' );
		if ( $term && ! is_wp_error( $term ) ) {
			$item['category'] = [
				'name' => $term->name,
				'url'  => '',
			];
		}
	}
	if ( ! empty( $values['listingcore_contact_name'] ) ) {
		$item['seller']['name'] = sanitize_text_field( (string) $values['listingcore_contact_name'] );
	}

	$item['url'] = '';

	return listingcore_theme_normalize_listing_item( $item );
}

/**
 * Redirect failed front-end logins back to the referring login form.
 *
 * @param string $username Username.
 */
function listingcore_theme_login_failed( $username ) { // phpcs:ignore Generic.CodeAnalysis.UnusedFunctionParameter.Found
	$referrer = wp_get_referer();
	if ( ! $referrer || false !== strpos( $referrer, 'wp-login.php' ) || false !== strpos( $referrer, 'wp-admin' ) ) {

/**
 * Handle dashboard POST actions (profile update, trash/publish) via WordPress APIs.
 */
function listingcore_theme_handle_account_post() {
	if ( 'POST' !== ( $_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] ?? '' ) || ! is_user_logged_in() ) { // phpcs:ignore WordPress.Security.ValidatedSanitizedInput.InputNotSanitized
		return;
	}

	if ( ! empty( $_POST['listingcore_theme_update_profile'] ) ) { // phpcs:ignore WordPress.Security.NonceVerification.Missing
		listingcore_theme_handle_profile_update();
		return;
	}

	if ( empty( $_POST['listingcore_theme_listing_action'] ) ) { // phpcs:ignore WordPress.Security.NonceVerification.Missing
		return;
	}

	$action  = sanitize_key( wp_unslash( $_POST['listingcore_theme_listing_action'] ) );
	$item_id = isset( $_POST['item'] ) ? absint( wp_unslash( $_POST['item'] ) ) : 0;
	$nonce   = isset( $_POST['_wpnonce'] ) ? sanitize_text_field( wp_unslash( $_POST['_wpnonce'] ) ) : '';

	if ( ! $item_id || ! wp_verify_nonce( $nonce, 'listingcore_theme_listing_action_' . $action . '_' . $item_id ) ) {
		return;
	}

	$handled = false;

	/**
	 * Let a data provider handle a dashboard listing action.
	 *
	 * Return true if the provider processed the action.
	 *
	 * @param bool   $handled Whether handled.
	 * @param string $action  Action key.
	 * @param int    $item_id Item ID.
	 */
	$handled = (bool) apply_filters( 'listingcore_theme_handle_listing_action', $handled, $action, $item_id );

	if ( $handled ) {
		return;
	}

	$post = get_post( $item_id );
	if ( ! $post || (int) $post->post_author !== get_current_user_id() ) {
		return;
	}

	$result = 'updated';

	if ( 'trash' === $action && current_user_can( 'delete_post', $item_id ) ) {
		wp_trash_post( $item_id );
		$result = 'trashed';
	} elseif ( 'publish' === $action && current_user_can( 'publish_post', $item_id ) ) {
		wp_update_post(
			[
				'ID'          => $item_id,
				'post_status' => 'publish',
			]
		);
		$result = 'published';
	} elseif ( 'unpublish' === $action && current_user_can( 'publish_post', $item_id ) ) {
		wp_update_post(
			[
				'ID'          => $item_id,
				'post_status' => 'draft',
			]
		);
		$result = 'unpublished';
	} else {
		return;
	}

	$urls = listingcore_theme_get_account_urls();
	$dest = $urls['listings'] ? $urls['listings'] : $urls['dashboard'];
	if ( $dest ) {
		wp_safe_redirect( add_query_arg( 'updated', $result, $dest ) );
		exit;
	}
}
add_action( 'template_redirect', 'listingcore_theme_handle_account_post', 5 );

/**
 * Update the logged-in user's profile with WordPress user APIs.
 */
function listingcore_theme_handle_profile_update() {
	if ( ! isset( $_POST['_wpnonce'] ) || ! wp_verify_nonce( sanitize_text_field( wp_unslash( $_POST['_wpnonce'] ) ), 'listingcore_theme_update_profile' ) ) {
		return;
	}

	$user_id = get_current_user_id();
	if ( ! $user_id ) {
		return;
	}

	$display = isset( $_POST['display_name'] ) ? sanitize_text_field( wp_unslash( $_POST['display_name'] ) ) : '';
	$first   = isset( $_POST['first_name'] ) ? sanitize_text_field( wp_unslash( $_POST['first_name'] ) ) : '';
	$last    = isset( $_POST['last_name'] ) ? sanitize_text_field( wp_unslash( $_POST['last_name'] ) ) : '';
	$email   = isset( $_POST['email'] ) ? sanitize_email( wp_unslash( $_POST['email'] ) ) : '';
	$website = isset( $_POST['website'] ) ? esc_url_raw( wp_unslash( $_POST['website'] ) ) : '';
	$bio     = isset( $_POST['bio'] ) ? sanitize_textarea_field( wp_unslash( $_POST['bio'] ) ) : '';

	$userdata = [
		'ID'           => $user_id,
		'display_name' => $display,
		'first_name'   => $first,
		'last_name'    => $last,
		'user_url'     => $website,
		'description'  => $bio,
	];

	$notice = 'profile';

	if ( $email && is_email( $email ) ) {
		$exists = email_exists( $email );
		if ( ! $exists || (int) $exists === $user_id ) {
			$userdata['user_email'] = $email;
		} else {
			$notice = 'email-taken';
		}
	} elseif ( isset( $_POST['email'] ) && '' !== trim( (string) wp_unslash( $_POST['email'] ) ) ) {
		$notice = 'email-invalid';
	}

	if ( 'profile' === $notice ) {
		$result = wp_update_user( $userdata );
		if ( is_wp_error( $result ) ) {
			$notice = 'profile-error';
		}
	}

	$pass1 = isset( $_POST['pass1'] ) ? (string) wp_unslash( $_POST['pass1'] ) : ''; // phpcs:ignore WordPress.Security.ValidatedSanitizedInput.InputNotSanitized
	$pass2 = isset( $_POST['pass2'] ) ? (string) wp_unslash( $_POST['pass2'] ) : ''; // phpcs:ignore WordPress.Security.ValidatedSanitizedInput.InputNotSanitized
	$curr  = isset( $_POST['current_password'] ) ? (string) wp_unslash( $_POST['current_password'] ) : ''; // phpcs:ignore WordPress.Security.ValidatedSanitizedInput.InputNotSanitized

	if ( '' !== $pass1 || '' !== $pass2 ) {
		$user = get_user_by( 'id', $user_id );
		if ( ! $user || ! wp_check_password( $curr, $user->user_pass, $user_id ) ) {
			$notice = 'password-current';
		} elseif ( $pass1 !== $pass2 ) {
			$notice = 'password-mismatch';
		} elseif ( strlen( $pass1 ) < 8 ) {
			$notice = 'password-short';
		} else {
			wp_set_password( $pass1, $user_id );
			wp_set_current_user( $user_id );
			wp_set_auth_cookie( $user_id, true );
			$notice = 'password';
		}
	}

	/**
	 * Fires after the theme attempts a profile update.
	 *
	 * @param int    $user_id User ID.
	 * @param string $notice  Notice key.
	 */
	do_action( 'listingcore_theme_profile_updated', $user_id, $notice );

	$urls = listingcore_theme_get_account_urls();
	$dest = $urls['profile'] ? $urls['profile'] : $urls['dashboard'];
	if ( $dest ) {
		wp_safe_redirect( add_query_arg( 'updated', $notice, $dest ) );
		exit;
	}
}

/**
 * Dashboard flash notice from `updated` query arg.
 *
 * @return array{type: string, text: string}|null
 */
function listingcore_theme_get_account_flash() {
	$key = isset( $_GET['updated'] ) ? sanitize_key( wp_unslash( $_GET['updated'] ) ) : ''; // phpcs:ignore WordPress.Security.NonceVerification.Recommended
	if ( '' === $key ) {
		$key = isset( $_GET['login'] ) ? sanitize_key( wp_unslash( $_GET['login'] ) ) : ''; // phpcs:ignore WordPress.Security.NonceVerification.Recommended
	}
	if ( '' === $key && isset( $_GET['checkemail'] ) ) { // phpcs:ignore WordPress.Security.NonceVerification.Recommended
		$key = 'checkemail-' . sanitize_key( wp_unslash( $_GET['checkemail'] ) );
	}

	$map = [
		'failed'          => [ 'error', __( 'The username or password is incorrect.', 'listingcore-theme' ) ],
		'trashed'         => [ 'success', __( 'The item was moved to the trash.', 'listingcore-theme' ) ],
		'published'       => [ 'success', __( 'The item is now published.', 'listingcore-theme' ) ],
		'unpublished'     => [ 'success', __( 'The item is now a draft.', 'listingcore-theme' ) ],
		'profile'         => [ 'success', __( 'Your profile was updated.', 'listingcore-theme' ) ],

Phase 3 is complete. Phase 4 was not started.

Assign the **Account Dashboard** page template to enable the front-end account area. Login, register, and lost-password templates are optional; WordPress `wp-login.php` is styled either way.

## Dashboard components
Shell with identity header, optional counts, desktop sidebar, mobile account drawer (same drawer utility), overview, My Listings cards, add/edit panels, profile, favorites.

## Account components
WordPress-native login (`wp_login_form`), registration (when `users_can_register`), lost/reset password posting to `wp-login.php`, header login/register/post/avatar menu, reusable account nav.

## Form components
Shared field, notice, confirm dialog, stepper, image uploader, listing add/edit form, preview that reuses Phase 2 card/seller.

## Seller components
Private account profile vs public `author.php` seller profile. Public view never includes password, private email, or phone.

## Favorites components
Favorites panel + empty state. Items only if `listingcore_theme_favorite_items` supplies them. Remove is a POST form only when a provider gives a URL.

## Files added
`inc/account.php`  
`template-dashboard.php`, `template-login.php`, `template-register.php`, `template-lost-password.php`, `author.php`  
`assets/css/account.css`, `assets/js/account.js`  
`template-parts/form/{notice,field,uploader,confirm,listing,preview}.php`  
`template-parts/account/{nav,header-actions,login,register,lost-password}.php`  
`template-parts/dashboard/{shell,summary,panel-home,panel-listings,listing-row,panel-add,panel-edit,panel-profile,panel-favorites}.php`  
`template-parts/listing/{status,seller-profile}.php`

## Files modified
`functions.php`, `header.php`, `front-page.php`, `inc/enqueue.php`, `inc/template-hooks.php`, `style.css`, `assets/css/listings.css`, `assets/js/main.js`, `template-parts/listing/empty.php`, `template-parts/listing/badges.php`, `languages/listingcore-theme.pot`

## Files removed
None.

## Provider contracts
`listingcore_theme_account_urls`  
`listingcore_theme_post_listing_url`  
`listingcore_theme_account_nav`  
`listingcore_theme_dashboard_counts` (null = omit; do not invent)  
`listingcore_theme_dashboard_listings`  
`listingcore_theme_dashboard_listing_actions`  
`listingcore_theme_handle_listing_action`  
`listingcore_theme_favorite_items` / `listingcore_theme_is_favorited` (existing `favorite_enabled` still applies)  
`listingcore_theme_public_seller` / `listingcore_theme_profile`  
`listingcore_theme_listing_form` (`can_submit`, `action`, `values`, `errors`, `success` only after a real save)  
`listingcore_theme_map_post_status`

## Accessibility
Labeled fields with required text (not placeholder-only), error `aria-describedby` / `aria-invalid`, notices with `aria-live`, confirm `<dialog>`, stepper `aria-current`, drawer reuse, Escape/focus restore for account menu, reduced motion on uploader progress.

## Security
Output escaped at the boundary. Profile/listing actions are POST + nonce + ownership/capability. No destructive GET. Phone stays in private profile meta. Public seller omits account email/password.

## Performance
Account CSS/JS load only on dashboard/auth/author templates. Header account uses existing `listings.css` + `main.js`. Listing form does not insert posts. Count queries run only when the user can `edit_posts` and the provider did not supply counts.

## Quality gates
`php -l` all PHP, `theme.json` valid, template/require paths resolve, JS syntax OK, CSS braces OK, POT regenerated (334 strings). Still absent: CPT/taxonomy registration, shortcodes, TGM, `is_plugin_active`, Google Fonts.

## Remaining limitations
- Add Listing does not save until a provider sets `can_submit` and `action`.
- Favorites have no storage without a provider.
- Expired/sold/rejected statuses appear only when supplied.
- Messages nav is hidden until a URL is supplied.
- Native WP register/reset may still land on `wp-login.php` for some flows; that screen is themed.
- Live 360–1440 browser pass was not run here (no WordPress runtime).

STOP.

PHASE 3 IS COMPLETE AND APPROVED.

DO NOT IMPLEMENT PHASE 4 FULLY YET.

Begin PHASE 4A ONLY:

LISTINGCORE INTEGRATION DISCOVERY AND CONTRACT DESIGN.

The objective is to inspect the ACTUAL ListingCore plugin/project available in the workspace and determine exactly how the theme can integrate with it while remaining completely optional and independent.

==================================================
NON-NEGOTIABLE ARCHITECTURE
===========================

The theme MUST remain fully functional with ZERO plugins.

ListingCore MUST remain optional.

The theme must NOT:

* register the ListingCore CPT
* register ListingCore taxonomies
* recreate ListingCore database tables
* recreate ListingCore business logic
* recreate ListingCore payment logic
* recreate ListingCore authentication
* recreate ListingCore favorites storage
* recreate ListingCore submission processing
* duplicate ListingCore queries unnecessarily

The theme provides PRESENTATION.

ListingCore provides DATA + BUSINESS LOGIC.

==================================================

1. FIND THE ACTUAL LISTINGCORE SOURCE
   ==================================================

Search the workspace for the actual ListingCore plugin/source.

Do not assume its architecture.

Identify:

* plugin bootstrap file
* version
* namespaces
* classes
* CPT registration
* taxonomy registration
* custom fields
* metadata
* database tables
* REST API
* AJAX
* hooks
* filters
* actions
* submission handlers
* dashboard handlers
* favorite handlers
* payment handlers
* user/account handlers
* template loading
* shortcodes
* URL/page configuration
* status definitions

Do NOT modify ListingCore during this phase.

==================================================
2. IDENTIFY THE LISTING DATA MODEL
==================================

Determine exactly how ListingCore represents:

* listing ID
* title
* description
* excerpt
* price
* price type
* category
* location
* address
* images
* featured
* promoted
* verified
* status
* seller/user
* contact information
* created date
* updated date
* expiration
* custom fields
* views
* favorites
* related listings

Record the actual source of each field.

Do not guess.

If a field does not exist, explicitly report that.

==================================================
3. IDENTIFY CPT AND TAXONOMIES
==============================

Determine the actual:

* listing post type
* category taxonomy
* location taxonomy
* tag taxonomy
* other relevant taxonomies

Record:

* exact slugs
* public/private status
* rewrite behavior
* supported query variables

The theme MUST NOT register them.

==================================================
4. IDENTIFY LISTING STATUSES
============================

Find the actual statuses ListingCore supports.

Examples may include:

* publish
* pending
* draft
* expired
* sold
* rejected
* archived

Do not assume these exist.

Map the actual statuses to:

listingcore_theme_map_post_status

or an equivalent clean provider interface.

==================================================
5. IDENTIFY LISTING URLS
========================

Determine how ListingCore generates:

* listing permalink
* category URL
* location URL
* seller URL
* add listing URL
* edit listing URL
* dashboard URL
* favorites URL
* login URL
* registration URL

Do not hard-code URLs if ListingCore already provides them.

==================================================
6. IDENTIFY LISTING QUERY SYSTEM
================================

Determine how ListingCore retrieves listings.

Inspect:

* WP_Query
* custom query classes
* REST endpoints
* filters
* custom SQL
* meta queries
* taxonomy queries

Determine whether the theme can safely integrate with the query using:

* pre_get_posts
* provider filters

ListingCore source was found **outside this theme repo**, at `C:\xampp\htdocs\sitefact-test\wp-content\plugins\listingcore`. It was inspected only. No plugin files were edited, no adapter was added, and Phase 4B was not started.

---

# PHASE 4A REPORT — ListingCore Integration Discovery and Contract Design

## 1. ListingCore plugin architecture

**Location (actual source):** `C:\xampp\htdocs\sitefact-test\wp-content\plugins\listingcore\`

Not present in:
- `C:\Projects\listingcore_theme`
- Local WP `C:\Users\ACER\Local Sites\listingcore` (theme is there; plugins folder is empty except `index.php`)
- `C:\xampp\htdocs\listingcore` (stock WordPress + Akismet only)

**Bootstrap:** `listingcore/listingcore.php`  
**Version:** `1.0.1` (`LISTINGCORE_VERSION`, header, `readme.txt`)  
**Requires:** WordPress 6.0+, PHP 8.0+  
**Text domain:** `listingcore`  
**License:** GPLv2 or later

Architecture is **hybrid**:

1. Procedural modules required from the bootstrap (current source of truth).
2. Namespaced classes under `includes/Listings/*` and `includes/Theme/*`.
3. `\ListingCore\Core\Plugin` singleton (`ARCHITECTURE = '2A'`) that boots and currently loads **no extra business modules**.

**Namespaces / classes:**

| Class | Role |
|---|---|
| `ListingCore\Core\Plugin` | Bootstrap container only |
| `ListingCore\Listings\PostTypes` | CPT registration |
| `ListingCore\Listings\Meta` | Listing meta schema + get/update |
| `ListingCore\Listings\PackageMeta` | Package meta schema |
| `ListingCore\Listings\FieldRegistry` | Third-party field extension seam |
| `ListingCore\Listings\Query` | WP_Query builder |
| `ListingCore\Listings\Submission` | Create/update listings |
| `ListingCore\Listings\PaidListing` | Paid entitlements |
| `ListingCore\Listings\ViewCount` | View increment |
| `ListingCore\Theme\ListingCard` | Plugin card HTML |
| `ListingCore\Theme\PriceFormatter` | Price string |
| `ListingCore\Theme\PackageSelector` | Package UI |
| `ListingCore\Theme\ContactForm` | Contact form renderer |
| `ListingCore\Theme\Wishlist` | Favorites read/render |
| `ListingCore\Theme\Seo` | JSON-LD |
| `ListingCore_Meta_Boxes` | Admin metaboxes (un-namespaced) |

**No custom database tables.** Storage is WP posts, post meta, term meta (`cp_category_icon`), user meta (`_listingcore_wishlist`), options (`listingcore_submit_page`, fallback `cp_submit_page`), transients (contact rate limit), and WooCommerce order item meta when paid listings are used.

**Constants:** `LISTINGCORE_VERSION`, `LISTINGCORE_DIR`, `LISTINGCORE_URI`.

**Roles:** `listing_poster`, `listing_moderator` (plus extra caps on `administrator`). Capability type for listings is `listing` with `map_meta_cap`.

---

## 2. CPT

**`listing`**
- Public, UI, REST, nav menus, archive, export
- Rewrite slug: `listings` (`with_front` false)
- `query_var`: true (query var is `listing`)
- Supports: title, editor, excerpt, thumbnail, comments, revisions, author, custom-fields
- Bound taxonomies in CPT args: `listing_category`, `listing_tag`, `listing_location` (`listing_condition` is registered separately)
- `capability_type`: `listing`
- `has_archive`: true → archive URL `/listings/`

**`listing_package`**
- `public` false, `show_ui` true
- No rewrite
- Supports title + editor
- REST enabled
- Used only for paid plans

The theme must not register either.

---

## 3. Taxonomies

| Taxonomy | Hierarchical | Public | Rewrite slug | Query var |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `listing_category` | yes | yes | `listing-category` | `listing_category` |
| `listing_tag` | no | yes | `listing-tag` | `listing_tag` |
| `listing_location` | yes | yes | `location` | `listing_location` |
| `listing_condition` | no | yes | `condition` | `listing_condition` |

All are `show_in_rest` true.

**Important:** search, REST, shortcodes, and cards do **not** query `listing_location` or `listing_condition`. Location search uses post meta `_listingcore_city`. Condition on listings is `_listingcore_condition` meta. Those two taxonomies are registered but unused by query/forms.

Category icons: term meta `cp_category_icon` (ClassiPress leftover key).

---

## 4. Data model

Mapped to the theme DTO. “Does not exist” means ListingCore has no such field.

| Theme / product field | Exists? | Actual source |
|---|---|---|
| Listing ID | yes | `WP_Post->ID`, post type `listing` |
| Title | yes | `post_title` |
| Description | yes | `post_content` |
| Excerpt | yes | `post_excerpt` / `get_the_excerpt()` (REST returns excerpt) |
| Price | yes | `_listingcore_price` via `Meta::get($id, 'price')` |
| Price type | yes | `_listingcore_price_type` — `fixed`, `negotiable`, `on_call`, `free` |
| Currency | yes | `_listingcore_currency` — USD/EUR/GBP/INR/AUD/CAD/JPY (frontend default INR) |
| Listing type | yes | `_listingcore_ad_type` — `sell`, `buy`, `rent`, `service`, `free` |
| Category | yes | taxonomy `listing_category` |
| Location (display) | yes | `_listingcore_city` + `_listingcore_country` (cards); also state |
| Address | yes | `_listingcore_address` (`context: none` in schema; shown on plugin single template) |
| City/state/country/zip | yes | `_listingcore_city/_state/_country/_zip` |
| Lat/lng | yes | `_listingcore_lat/_lng` — REST `edit` context, staff-writable |
| Images | **featured image only** | `_thumbnail_id` / `set_post_thumbnail()` |
| Gallery | **does not exist** | no gallery meta, no extra attachments API |
| Featured | yes | `_listingcore_featured` (`'1'` / `''`) — **not** sticky |
| Promoted | **does not exist** | closest analog is `_listingcore_urgent` |
| Urgent | yes | `_listingcore_urgent` |
| Verified | yes | `_listingcore_verified` (listing-level, staff/package) |
| Status | WP native only | `post_status`: `publish`, `pending`, `draft`, `private`, `trash` |
| Seller | yes | `post_author` |
| Contact phone/email | yes | `_listingcore_phone`, `_listingcore_phone2`, `_listingcore_contact_email` — **sensitive**; hide flags `_listingcore_hide_phone/_hide_email` |
| Created | yes | `post_date` |
| Updated | yes | `post_modified` |
| Expiration | yes | `_listingcore_expiry_date` (`Y-m-d`). Listing **stays published** on expiry |
| Views | yes | `_listingcore_views` (integer, plugin increments) |
| Favorites | yes | **user** meta `_listingcore_wishlist` (array of listing IDs), not listing meta |
| Related | derived | same `listing_category`, `Query::query` / REST `/similar` |
| Brand/model/year | yes | `_listingcore_brand/_model/_year` — admin metabox; **not** in frontend `EDITABLE_FIELDS` |
| Website/video | yes | `_listingcore_website/_video_url` |
| Condition | yes | `_listingcore_condition` meta (`new/used/refurb`) |
| Paid linkage | yes | `_listingcore_paid_order_id`, `_listingcore_paid_package_id`, `_listingcore_renewal_order_id` — **private** |
| Seller bio/phone as user profile | **no ListingCore fields** | WP `user_url`, `description` only |

`Meta::FIELD_SCHEMA` is the canonical listing meta contract. `FieldRegistry` is for extension keys matching `/^_listingcore_[a-z0-9_]+$/`.

---

## 5. Statuses

ListingCore does **not** register custom post statuses.

**Actual post statuses used:**

| WP status | How ListingCore uses it | Theme `listingcore_theme_map_post_status` |
|---|---|---|
| `publish` | Free submit publishes immediately; paid publish after WooCommerce complete | `published` |
| `pending` | Paid checkout / revoke | `pending` |
| `draft` | Standard WP; frontend submit does **not** create drafts | `draft` |
| `trash` | Theme WP fallback only. Plugin delete uses `wp_delete_post(..., true)` (permanent) | `archived` |
| `private` | Capability exists; no frontend flow | unmapped (empty) |

**Do not map these as plugin statuses — they do not exist:** `sold`, `rejected`, `expired` (as `post_status`), `archived`.

**Expiry is meta, not status.** Cron emails the author and, for paid listings, clears featured/urgent/verified. The listing remains `publish`. The commented unpublished line in `expiry-cron.php` is disabled.

Adapter recommendation: keep WP map for `publish/pending/draft/trash`. Optionally, if `_listingcore_expiry_date` is set and `<= current_time('Y-m-d')`, overlay presentation status `expired` via `listingcore_theme_map_post_status` **or** a separate DTO flag. Do not invent `sold`/`rejected`.

---

## 6. URLs

| Destination | ListingCore source | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Listing permalink | `get_permalink()` | rewrite `/listings/{slug}/` |
| Archive | `get_post_type_archive_link('listing')` | `/listings/` |
| Category | `get_term_link()` on `listing_category` | `/listing-category/{slug}/` |
| Location taxonomy URL | `get_term_link()` on `listing_location` | `/location/{slug}/` — taxonomy unused by search |
| Location search | GET `listingcore_location` on archive | exact `_listingcore_city` |

## 9. Submission flow

**Rendering:** `[listingcore_listing_form]` → `listingcore_locate_template('listing/submit-form.php')`

**Nonce:** field `listingcore_submission_nonce`, action `listingcore_submit_listing` (plugin-owned).

**Auth:** must be logged in; else redirect `wp_login_url`. Capability: `publish_listings`.

**Paid path:** if `listingcore_package_id` selected → validate package/WooCommerce → reuse unfinished checkout or `create_pending` → WC order → redirect checkout.

**Success:** `wp_safe_redirect(get_permalink($id))`.  
**Error:** redirect referer with `listingcore_submission_error`.

**Edit:** nonce `listingcore_update_listing` / `listingcore_update_nonce`. Status and author are not writable. Image replace/remove supported.

<?php
/**
 * Silence is golden.
 *
 * @package ListingCoreTheme
 */

defined( 'ABSPATH' ) || exit;

<?php
/**
 * Optional ListingCore presentation adapter.
 *
 * Translates ListingCore data into theme DTOs and query contracts.
 * Loaded only when ListingCore is present. Inert when the plugin is absent
 * or below the minimum tested version.
 *
 * The theme owns presentation. ListingCore owns data and business logic.
 * This file does not register post types, taxonomies, or shortcodes, and it
 * does not write listing meta, handle submission, favorites, or payments.
 *
 * @package ListingCoreTheme
 * @since   1.0.0
 */

defined( 'ABSPATH' ) || exit;

/**
 * Minimum ListingCore version this adapter is tested against.
 *
 * Inspected source: ListingCore 1.0.1.
 */
const LISTINGCORE_THEME_LISTINGCORE_MIN_VERSION = '1.0.1';

/**
 * Whether ListingCore bootstrap signals are present and compatible.
 *
 * Uses multiple signals. Does not autoload classes.
 *
 * @return bool
 */
function listingcore_theme_listingcore_is_available() {
	if ( ! defined( 'LISTINGCORE_VERSION' ) ) {
		return false;
	}

	if ( version_compare( LISTINGCORE_VERSION, LISTINGCORE_THEME_LISTINGCORE_MIN_VERSION, '<' ) ) {
		return false;
	}

	return class_exists( '\ListingCore\Listings\Meta', false )
		&& class_exists( '\ListingCore\Listings\Query', false );
}

/**
 * Whether ListingCore content types are registered for this request.
 *
 * CPT/taxonomies exist only after init.
 *
 * @return bool
 */
function listingcore_theme_listingcore_is_active() {
	if ( ! listingcore_theme_listingcore_is_available() ) {
		return false;
	}

	if ( ! did_action( 'init' ) ) {
		return false;
	}

	return post_type_exists( 'listing' ) && taxonomy_exists( 'listing_category' );
}

/**
 * Hook theme contracts after ListingCore registers its types.
 *
 * @return void
 */
function listingcore_theme_listingcore_bootstrap() {
	if ( ! listingcore_theme_listingcore_is_active() ) {
		return;
	}

	add_filter( 'listingcore_theme_listing_card_post_types', 'listingcore_theme_listingcore_card_post_types' );
	add_filter( 'listingcore_theme_is_listing', 'listingcore_theme_listingcore_is_listing', 10, 2 );
	add_filter( 'listingcore_theme_listing_item', 'listingcore_theme_listingcore_listing_item', 10, 2 );
	add_filter( 'listingcore_theme_listing_taxonomy', 'listingcore_theme_listingcore_taxonomy' );
	add_filter( 'listingcore_theme_listing_category_query_key', 'listingcore_theme_listingcore_category_query_key' );
	add_filter( 'listingcore_theme_category_query_args', 'listingcore_theme_listingcore_category_query_args' );
	add_filter( 'listingcore_theme_location_items', 'listingcore_theme_listingcore_location_items' );
	add_filter( 'listingcore_theme_search_form_action', 'listingcore_theme_listingcore_search_form_action' );
	add_filter( 'listingcore_theme_filter_query_keys', 'listingcore_theme_listingcore_filter_query_keys' );
	add_filter( 'listingcore_theme_filter_state', 'listingcore_theme_listingcore_filter_state' );
	add_filter( 'listingcore_theme_allowed_orderby', 'listingcore_theme_listingcore_allowed_orderby' );
	add_filter( 'listingcore_theme_sort_choices', 'listingcore_theme_listingcore_sort_choices' );
	add_filter( 'listingcore_theme_featured_listing_query', 'listingcore_theme_listingcore_featured_query' );
	add_action( 'listingcore_theme_apply_listing_filters', 'listingcore_theme_listingcore_apply_listing_filters', 10, 2 );
}
add_action( 'init', 'listingcore_theme_listingcore_bootstrap', 20 );

/**
 * Use the ListingCore listing post type for listing cards.
 *
 * @param string[] $types Post types.
 * @return string[]
 */
function listingcore_theme_listingcore_card_post_types( $types ) {
	unset( $types );
	return [ 'listing' ];
}

/**
 * Treat ListingCore listing posts as listing details.
 *
 * @param bool         $is_listing Whether this is a listing.
 * @param WP_Post|null $post       Post.
 * @return bool
 */
function listingcore_theme_listingcore_is_listing( $is_listing, $post ) {
	if ( $post instanceof WP_Post && 'listing' === $post->post_type ) {
		return true;
	}

	return (bool) $is_listing;
}

/**
 * ListingCore category taxonomy slug.
 *
 * @return string
 */
function listingcore_theme_listingcore_taxonomy() {
	return 'listing_category';
}

/**
 * ListingCore category request key (not WordPress `cat`).
 *
 * @return string
 */
function listingcore_theme_listingcore_category_query_key() {
	return 'listing_category';
}

/**
 * Force category queries onto listing_category.
 *
 * @param array $args get_categories args.
 * @return array
 */
function listingcore_theme_listingcore_category_query_args( $args ) {
	if ( ! is_array( $args ) ) {
		$args = [];
	}

	$args['taxonomy'] = 'listing_category';

	return $args;
}

/**
 * Omit location cards. Searchable city data is listing meta, not a taxonomy,
 * and scanning listings for DISTINCT cities is not done here.
 *
 * @param array $items Location items.
 * @return array
 */
function listingcore_theme_listingcore_location_items( $items ) {
	unset( $items );
	return [];
}

/**
 * Send classifieds search to the listing archive so `s` and location apply
 * to the ListingCore main query.
 *
 * @param string $url Form action.
 * @return string
 */
function listingcore_theme_listingcore_search_form_action( $url ) {
	$archive = get_post_type_archive_link( 'listing' );

	return $archive ? $archive : $url;
}

/**
 * Keep listing_category (not `cat`) in public result URLs.
 *
 * @param string[] $keys Query keys.
 * @return string[]
 */
function listingcore_theme_listingcore_filter_query_keys( $keys ) {
	$keys = is_array( $keys ) ? $keys : [];
	$keys = array_values( array_diff( $keys, [ 'cat' ] ) );

	if ( ! in_array( 'listing_category', $keys, true ) ) {
		$keys[] = 'listing_category';
	}

	return $keys;
}

/**
 * Mark filters that this adapter actually applies on listing queries.
 *
 * @param array $state Filter state.
 * @return array
 */
function listingcore_theme_listingcore_filter_state( $state ) {
	if ( ! is_array( $state ) ) {
		return $state;
	}

	if ( ! isset( $state['applied'] ) || ! is_array( $state['applied'] ) ) {
		$state['applied'] = [];
	}

	$state['applied']['location']  = '' !== (string) $state['location'];
	$state['applied']['min_price'] = listingcore_theme_listingcore_is_price_value( $state['min_price'] );
	$state['applied']['max_price'] = listingcore_theme_listingcore_is_price_value( $state['max_price'] );

	if ( ! empty( $state['category'] ) ) {
		$state['applied']['category'] = true;
	}

	return $state;
}

/**
 * Add ListingCore-supported sort keys.
 *
 * @param string[] $keys Keys.
 * @return string[]
 */
function listingcore_theme_listingcore_allowed_orderby( $keys ) {
	$keys = is_array( $keys ) ? $keys : [];

	foreach ( [ 'price_asc', 'price_desc', 'views' ] as $key ) {
		if ( ! in_array( $key, $keys, true ) ) {
			$keys[] = $key;
		}
	}

	return $keys;
}

/**
 * Expose only sorts ListingCore can honor.
 *
 * @param array $choices Choices.
 * @return array
 */
function listingcore_theme_listingcore_sort_choices( $choices ) {
	$choices = is_array( $choices ) ? $choices : [];

	$choices['price_asc']  = [
		'label' => __( 'Price: low to high', 'listingcore-theme' ),
		'order' => 'ASC',
	];
	$choices['price_desc'] = [
		'label' => __( 'Price: high to low', 'listingcore-theme' ),
		'order' => 'DESC',
	];
	$choices['views']      = [
		'label' => __( 'Most viewed', 'listingcore-theme' ),
		'order' => 'DESC',
	];

	return $choices;
}

/**
 * Homepage featured strip from `_listingcore_featured`, not sticky posts.
 *
 * Separate from the archive main query.
 *
 * @param WP_Query|null $query Existing query.
 * @return WP_Query|null
 */
function listingcore_theme_listingcore_featured_query( $query ) {
	unset( $query );

	if ( ! class_exists( '\ListingCore\Listings\Query', false ) ) {
		return null;
	}

	$featured = \ListingCore\Listings\Query::featured(
		[
			'posts_per_page' => 3,
			'no_found_rows'  => true,
		]
	);

	return $featured instanceof WP_Query ? $featured : null;
}

/**
 * Fill listing DTO fields from ListingCore. Read-only.
 *
 * @param array   $item Presentation item.
 * @param WP_Post $post Post.
 * @return array
 */
function listingcore_theme_listingcore_listing_item( $item, $post ) {
	if ( ! is_array( $item ) || ! $post instanceof WP_Post || 'listing' !== $post->post_type ) {
		return $item;
	}

	if ( ! class_exists( '\ListingCore\Listings\Meta', false ) ) {
		return $item;
	}

	$id = (int) $post->ID;

	$item['price']    = listingcore_theme_listingcore_format_price( $id );
	$item['location'] = listingcore_theme_listingcore_format_location( $id );
	$item['featured'] = '1' === (string) \ListingCore\Listings\Meta::get( $id, 'featured' );
	// Theme "promoted" presents ListingCore "urgent". The plugin has no promoted field.
	$item['promoted'] = '1' === (string) \ListingCore\Listings\Meta::get( $id, 'urgent' );
	$item['verified'] = '1' === (string) \ListingCore\Listings\Meta::get( $id, 'verified' );

	$mapped = listingcore_theme_map_post_status( $post->post_status );
	$expiry = (string) \ListingCore\Listings\Meta::get( $id, 'expiry_date' );
	if ( $expiry && $expiry <= current_time( 'Y-m-d' ) && 'publish' === $post->post_status ) {
		$item['status'] = 'expired';
	} elseif ( 'published' !== $mapped ) {
		$item['status'] = $mapped;
	}

	$image_id = ! empty( $item['image_id'] ) ? (int) $item['image_id'] : (int) get_post_thumbnail_id( $id );
	$item['image_id'] = $image_id;
	if ( $image_id ) {
		$alt = get_post_meta( $image_id, '_wp_attachment_image_alt', true );
		if ( is_string( $alt ) && '' !== $alt ) {
			$item['image_alt'] = $alt;
		}
	}

	$item['meta']   = listingcore_theme_listingcore_public_meta( $id );
	$item['seller'] = listingcore_theme_listingcore_public_seller( isset( $item['seller'] ) && is_array( $item['seller'] ) ? $item['seller'] : [], $post );

	// Favorites and contact POST are later phases.
	$item['favorite_url'] = '';
	$item['contact_url']  = '';

	return $item;
}

/**
 * Format a public price string from ListingCore meta.
 *
 * Templates escape this value. Do not pass PriceFormatter output (it is pre-escaped).
 *
 * @param int $post_id Listing ID.
 * @return string
 */
function listingcore_theme_listingcore_format_price( $post_id ) {
	$price = \ListingCore\Listings\Meta::get( $post_id, 'price' );

	if ( '' === $price || null === $price || ! is_numeric( $price ) ) {
		return '';
	}

	$currency   = (string) \ListingCore\Listings\Meta::get( $post_id, 'currency' );
	$price_type = (string) \ListingCore\Listings\Meta::get( $post_id, 'price_type' );
	$symbols    = [
		'USD' => '$',
		'EUR' => '€',
		'GBP' => '£',
		'INR' => '₹',
		'AUD' => '$',
		'CAD' => '$',
		'JPY' => '¥',
	];

	$symbol = isset( $symbols[ $currency ] ) ? $symbols[ $currency ] : '';
	$text   = $symbol . number_format_i18n( (float) $price );

	if ( '' !== $currency ) {
		$text .= ' ' . $currency;
	}

	if ( '' !== $price_type && 'fixed' !== $price_type ) {
		$labels = [
			'negotiable' => __( 'Negotiable', 'listingcore-theme' ),
			'on_call'    => __( 'On call', 'listingcore-theme' ),
			'free'       => __( 'Free', 'listingcore-theme' ),
		];
		$suffix = isset( $labels[ $price_type ] ) ? $labels[ $price_type ] : $price_type;
		$text  .= ' (' . $suffix . ')';
	}

	return $text;
}

/**
 * Public location line: city, country (ListingCore search uses city meta).
 *
 * @param int $post_id Listing ID.
 * @return string
 */
function listingcore_theme_listingcore_format_location( $post_id ) {
	$city    = (string) \ListingCore\Listings\Meta::get( $post_id, 'city' );
	$country = (string) \ListingCore\Listings\Meta::get( $post_id, 'country' );

	return implode( ', ', array_filter( [ $city, $country ] ) );
}

/**
 * Public detail fields only. No contact, coordinates, or payment meta.
 *
 * @param int $post_id Listing ID.
 * @return array<string, string>
 */
function listingcore_theme_listingcore_public_meta( $post_id ) {
	$map = [
		'ad_type'    => __( 'Type', 'listingcore-theme' ),
		'condition'  => __( 'Condition', 'listingcore-theme' ),
		'price_type' => __( 'Price type', 'listingcore-theme' ),
		'brand'      => __( 'Brand', 'listingcore-theme' ),
		'model'      => __( 'Model', 'listingcore-theme' ),
		'year'       => __( 'Year', 'listingcore-theme' ),
	];

	$ad_types = [
		'sell'    => __( 'For sale', 'listingcore-theme' ),
		'buy'     => __( 'Wanted', 'listingcore-theme' ),
		'rent'    => __( 'For rent', 'listingcore-theme' ),
		'service' => __( 'Service', 'listingcore-theme' ),
		'free'    => __( 'Free', 'listingcore-theme' ),
	];

	$conditions = [
		'new'    => __( 'New', 'listingcore-theme' ),
		'used'   => __( 'Used', 'listingcore-theme' ),
		'refurb' => __( 'Refurbished', 'listingcore-theme' ),
	];

	$price_types = [
		'fixed'      => __( 'Fixed', 'listingcore-theme' ),
		'negotiable' => __( 'Negotiable', 'listingcore-theme' ),
		'on_call'    => __( 'On call', 'listingcore-theme' ),
		'free'       => __( 'Free', 'listingcore-theme' ),
	];

	$meta = [];

	foreach ( $map as $field => $label ) {
		$value = \ListingCore\Listings\Meta::get( $post_id, $field );
		if ( '' === $value || null === $value || ! is_scalar( $value ) ) {
			continue;
		}

		$value = (string) $value;

		if ( 'ad_type' === $field && isset( $ad_types[ $value ] ) ) {
			$value = $ad_types[ $value ];
		} elseif ( 'condition' === $field && isset( $conditions[ $value ] ) ) {
			$value = $conditions[ $value ];
		} elseif ( 'price_type' === $field && isset( $price_types[ $value ] ) ) {
			$value = $price_types[ $value ];
		}

		$meta[ $label ] = $value;
	}

	return $meta;
}

/**
 * Public seller fields from the listing author. No email or phone.
 *
 * @param array   $seller Existing seller DTO.
 * @param WP_Post $post   Listing.
 * @return array
 */
function listingcore_theme_listingcore_public_seller( $seller, $post ) {
	$author_id = (int) $post->post_author;
	if ( ! $author_id ) {
		return $seller;
	}

	$bio     = get_the_author_meta( 'description', $author_id );
	$website = get_the_author_meta( 'user_url', $author_id );

	if ( is_string( $bio ) && '' !== $bio ) {
		$seller['bio'] = $bio;
	}

	if ( is_string( $website ) && '' !== $website ) {
		$seller['website'] = $website;
	}

	// Listing-level verified is not a seller identity flag.
	$seller['verified'] = false;

	return $seller;
}

/**
 * Apply ListingCore filters to the main query without a second WP_Query.
 *
 * Location on the listing archive is already applied by ListingCore's
 * `pre_get_posts`. Price sort/range uses Query helpers. Category uses the
 * listing_category taxonomy, never `cat`.
 *
 * @param WP_Query $query Main query.
 * @param array    $state Filter state.
 * @return void
 */
function listingcore_theme_listingcore_apply_listing_filters( $query, $state ) {
	if ( ! $query instanceof WP_Query || ! listingcore_theme_listingcore_is_listing_query( $query ) ) {
		return;
	}

	if ( ! class_exists( '\ListingCore\Listings\Query', false ) ) {
		return;
	}

	if ( $query->is_author() ) {
		$query->set( 'post_type', 'listing' );
	}

	$state = is_array( $state ) ? $state : [];
	$args  = [
		'meta_query' => listingcore_theme_listingcore_query_clause( $query->get( 'meta_query' ) ),
		'tax_query'  => listingcore_theme_listingcore_query_clause( $query->get( 'tax_query' ) ),
	];

	$location = isset( $state['location'] ) ? trim( (string) $state['location'] ) : '';
	if ( '' !== $location && ! listingcore_theme_listingcore_meta_query_has_key( $args['meta_query'], '_listingcore_city' ) ) {
		$args = \ListingCore\Listings\Query::with_location( $args, $location );
	}

	if ( listingcore_theme_listingcore_is_price_value( isset( $state['min_price'] ) ? $state['min_price'] : '' ) ) {
		$args = \ListingCore\Listings\Query::with_min_price( $args, (float) $state['min_price'] );
	}

	if ( listingcore_theme_listingcore_is_price_value( isset( $state['max_price'] ) ? $state['max_price'] : '' ) ) {
		$args = \ListingCore\Listings\Query::with_max_price( $args, (float) $state['max_price'] );
	}

	$existing_cat = $query->get( 'listing_category' );
	if ( ! $query->is_tax( 'listing_category' ) && empty( $existing_cat ) && ! empty( $state['category'] ) ) {
		$args = \ListingCore\Listings\Query::with_category( (int) $state['category'], $args );
	}

	$sort = isset( $state['sort'] ) ? (string) $state['sort'] : 'date';
	if ( 'views' === $sort ) {
		$args          = \ListingCore\Listings\Query::with_views( $args );
		$args['order'] = ! empty( $state['order'] ) ? $state['order'] : 'DESC';
	} elseif ( 'price_asc' === $sort ) {
		$args          = \ListingCore\Listings\Query::with_price_sort( $args );
		$args['order'] = 'ASC';
	} elseif ( 'price_desc' === $sort ) {
		$args          = \ListingCore\Listings\Query::with_price_sort( $args );
		$args['order'] = 'DESC';
	}

	if ( ! empty( $args['meta_query'] ) ) {
		$query->set( 'meta_query', $args['meta_query'] );
	}

	if ( ! empty( $args['tax_query'] ) ) {
		$query->set( 'tax_query', $args['tax_query'] );
	}

	if ( isset( $args['orderby'] ) ) {
		$query->set( 'orderby', $args['orderby'] );
	}

	if ( isset( $args['order'] ) ) {
		$query->set( 'order', $args['order'] );
	}
}

/**
 * Whether this main query is a ListingCore listings view.
 *
 * @param WP_Query $query Query.
 * @return bool
 */
function listingcore_theme_listingcore_is_listing_query( $query ) {
	if ( $query->is_post_type_archive( 'listing' ) ) {
		return true;
	}

	if ( $query->is_tax( [ 'listing_category', 'listing_tag', 'listing_location', 'listing_condition' ] ) ) {
		return true;
	}

	if ( $query->is_author() ) {
		return true;
	}

	$post_type = $query->get( 'post_type' );
	if ( 'listing' === $post_type || ( is_array( $post_type ) && in_array( 'listing', $post_type, true ) ) ) {
		return $query->is_search();
	}

	return false;
}

/**
 * Normalize a WP_Query clause to an array.
 *
 * @param mixed $clause Clause.
 * @return array
 */
function listingcore_theme_listingcore_query_clause( $clause ) {
	return is_array( $clause ) ? $clause : [];
}

/**
 * Whether a meta_query tree already contains a key (avoid duplicating city).
 *
 * @param array  $meta_query Meta query.
 * @param string $key        Meta key.
 * @return bool
 */
function listingcore_theme_listingcore_meta_query_has_key( $meta_query, $key ) {
	if ( ! is_array( $meta_query ) ) {
		return false;
	}

	foreach ( $meta_query as $clause ) {
		if ( ! is_array( $clause ) ) {
			continue;
		}

		if ( isset( $clause['key'] ) && $key === $clause['key'] ) {
			return true;
		}

		if ( listingcore_theme_listingcore_meta_query_has_key( $clause, $key ) ) {
			return true;
		}
	}

	return false;
}

/**
 * Whether a request value is a usable non-negative price.
 *
 * @param mixed $value Raw value.
 * @return bool
 */
function listingcore_theme_listingcore_is_price_value( $value ) {
	if ( '' === $value || null === $value || is_array( $value ) ) {
		return false;
	}

	if ( ! is_numeric( $value ) ) {
		return false;
	}

	return (float) $value >= 0;
}
